```sql
WITH joined_ranges AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.benche_kind,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_12h
    FROM pacific_dunes a
    LEFT JOIN pacific_dunes b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.benche_kind < a.benche_kind
     AND b.benche_kind >= a.benche_kind - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.benche_kind
),
derived AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT *, HOUR(benche_kind) AS silo_grade
    FROM joined_ranges
),
derived_2 AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(prior_rows_12h, 0) AS prior_rows_12h_filled,
        ABS(silo_grade - 11) AS played_at_hour_distance,
        DAYOFWEEK(benche_kind) AS played_at_dayofweek
    FROM derived
    WHERE TO_DATE(benche_kind) < DATE '2025-03-02'
),
exploded_detail AS (
    -- One row per play
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.benche_kind,
        s.prior_rows_12h,
        s.prior_ms_played_12h,
        s.silo_grade,
        s.prior_rows_12h_filled,
        s.played_at_dayofweek,
        p.id AS play_id,
        p.device AS play_device,
        p.benche_kind AS play_played_at,
        p.ms_played AS console_ref
    FROM derived_2 s
    JOIN pacific_dunes p ON p.listener_id = s.listener_id
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT silo_grade, play_id, play_device, prior_ms_played_12h
    FROM exploded_detail
) src
PIVOT (
    MIN(prior_ms_played_12h)
    FOR play_device IN ('speaker', 'phone', 'desktop', 'car')
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

joined_ranges = (
    df_pacific_dunes.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_pacific_dunes.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.listener_id") == F.col("a.listener_id"))
        & (F.col("b.benche_kind") < F.col("a.benche_kind"))
        & (F.col("b.benche_kind") >= F.col("a.benche_kind") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.benche_kind")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_12h"),
    )
)

derived = joined_ranges.select("*", F.hour(F.col("benche_kind")).alias("silo_grade"))

derived_2 = (
    derived
    .filter(F.to_date(F.col("benche_kind")) < F.lit("2025-03-02").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("prior_rows_12h"), F.lit(0)).alias("prior_rows_12h_filled"),
        F.abs(F.col("silo_grade") - 11).alias("played_at_hour_distance"),
        F.dayofweek(F.col("benche_kind")).alias("played_at_dayofweek"),
    )
)

exploded_detail = (
    derived_2.alias("s")
    .join(df_pacific_dunes.alias("p"), F.col("p.listener_id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.listener_id",
        "s.benche_kind",
        "s.prior_rows_12h",
        "s.prior_ms_played_12h",
        "s.silo_grade",
        "s.prior_rows_12h_filled",
        "s.played_at_dayofweek",
        F.col("p.id").alias("play_id"),
        F.col("p.device").alias("play_device"),
        F.col("p.benche_kind").alias("play_played_at"),
        F.col("p.ms_played").alias("console_ref"),
    )
)

result = (
    exploded_detail
    .groupBy("silo_grade", "play_id")
    .pivot("play_device", ["speaker", "phone", "desktop", "car"])
    .agg(F.min("prior_ms_played_12h"))
)
```

```sql
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        cur_humidity,
        pressure,
        firmware,
        TO_DATE(reading_ts) AS reading_ts_date
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts > TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 08:00:00'
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), reading_ts) / 365 AS years_since_reading_ts,
        YEAR(reading_ts) AS reading_ts_year
    FROM filtered
    WHERE device_code IN ('DV-03', 'DV-04')
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        cur_humidity,
        firmware,
        reading_ts_date,
        years_since_reading_ts,
        reading_ts_year
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure DESC, id) = 1
),
deduped_device_readings AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts_date DESC, id) AS row_num
        FROM deduped
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN cur_humidity >= 82 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS cur_humidity_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE device_code = 'DV-03') AS dv_03_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(reading_ts_year) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-01' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS reading_ts_year_per_dv_01,
    MIN(reading_ts_year) AS min_reading_ts_year,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(reading_ts_year, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS reading_ts_year_quartiles,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(device_code)) AS device_code_list
FROM deduped_device_readings
GROUP BY CASE WHEN cur_humidity >= 82 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

filtered = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01 08:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "cur_humidity",
        "pressure",
        "firmware",
        F.to_date("reading_ts").alias("reading_ts_date"),
    )
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("device_code").isin(["DV-03", "DV-04"]))
    .withColumn("years_since_reading_ts", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "reading_ts") / 365))
    .withColumn("reading_ts_year", F.year("reading_ts"))
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("pressure").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "cur_humidity",
        "firmware",
        "reading_ts_date",
        "years_since_reading_ts",
        "reading_ts_year",
    )
)

deduped_device_readings = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts_date").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped_device_readings
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("cur_humidity") >= 82, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("cur_humidity_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03", 1)).alias("dv_03_rows"),
        F.round(F.sum("reading_ts_year") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-01", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("reading_ts_year_per_dv_01"),
        F.min("reading_ts_year").alias("min_reading_ts_year"),
        F.percentile_approx("reading_ts_year", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("reading_ts_year_quartiles"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("device_code")).alias("device_code_list"),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH recent_forklift_logs AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouses_v_no,
        pallet_state,
        slot_minutes,
        pick_lines,
        received_on
    FROM forklift_logs
    WHERE received_on >= DATE '2025-01-22'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouses_v_no,
        pallet_state,
        slot_minutes,
        pick_lines,
        received_on,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(pallet_state), 1, 4) AS pallet_state_prefix
    FROM recent_forklift_logs
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the earliest row per warehouses_v_no
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouses_v_no,
        pallet_state,
        slot_minutes,
        pick_lines,
        received_on,
        pallet_state_prefix
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouses_v_no ORDER BY pick_lines, id) AS recency_rank
        FROM enriched
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Join warehouses_v
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouses_v_no,
        s.pallet_state,
        s.slot_minutes,
        s.pick_lines,
        s.received_on,
        s.pallet_state_prefix,
        w.received_date AS warehouses_v_received_date,
        w.lift_model AS warehouses_v_lift_model,
        w.flag_is_fragile AS warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile
    FROM latest_per_key s
    LEFT JOIN warehouses_v w ON w.id = s.warehouses_v_no
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouses_v_no,
        pallet_state,
        slot_minutes,
        pick_lines,
        received_on,
        pallet_state_prefix,
        warehouses_v_lift_model,
        warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(warehouses_v_lift_model) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile, warehouses_v_no)) AS distinct_warehouses_v_lift_model_in_warehouses_v,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pick_lines ASC, id) AS pick_lines_dense_rank,
        MAX(slot_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile, warehouses_v_no) AS warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile_warehouses_v_no_max,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile AS rows_in_warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile_warehouses_
    FROM joined
    WINDOW w_warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile AS (PARTITION BY warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile, warehouses_v_no)
),
enriched_2 AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN pick_lines_dense_rank >= 8 THEN 'large' WHEN pick_lines_dense_rank >= 4 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS pick_lines_dense_rank_tier,
        COALESCE(pallet_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS pallet_state_or_unknown,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(warehouses_v_lift_model), ' ', '_')) AS warehouses_v_lift_model_slug
    FROM with_windows
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach pallets metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pallets p WHERE p.warehouses_v_id = s.warehouses_v_no) AS pallet_count
    FROM enriched_2 s
),
stats AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile,
        MIN(pick_lines) AS min_pick_lines,
        MAX(received_on) AS last_received_on
    FROM profiled
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    warehouses_v_flag_is_fragile,
    CASE WHEN min_pick_lines >= 42 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN min_pick_lines >= 25 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS min_pick_lines_tier,
    COALESCE(min_pick_lines, 0) AS min_pick_lines_filled
FROM stats
ORDER BY min_pick_lines_filled DESC, min_pick_lines_tier NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
```

```sql
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at

        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_kwh_7d), 2) AS stddev_prior_kwh_7d,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_kwh_7d, 0.5) AS silo_kind,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING SUM(prior_kwh_7d) > 60.0
)
SELECT
    read_at_day,
    stddev_prior_kwh_7d,
    silo_kind,
    GREATEST(biome_note, cnt) AS debut_qty
FROM per_group
ORDER BY silo_kind DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
    df_orchards.alias("a")
    .join(

        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),

    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("biome_note"),
        F.sum("b.kwh").alias("prior_kwh_7d"),
```

```sql
WITH scoped_tour_packages AS (
    -- Scope the tour_packages rows
    SELECT
        id,
        tour_operator_no,
        pay_status,
        review_likes,
        reserved_ts,
        flag_is_private,
        ABS(review_likes - 171) AS review_likes_distance
    FROM tour_packages
    WHERE tour_operator_no <= 31
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous reserved_ts per pay_status
    SELECT *, LAG(reserved_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY pay_status ORDER BY reserved_ts, id) AS prev_reserved_ts
    FROM scoped_tour_packages
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 90 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_reserved_ts IS NULL OR reserved_ts > prev_reserved_ts + INTERVAL 90 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY pay_status ORDER BY reserved_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        pay_status,
        session_no,
        MIN(reserved_ts) AS session_start,
        MAX(reserved_ts) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(reserved_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(reserved_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY pay_status, session_no
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_end) AS session_end_month,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) AS session_start_month,
        events,
        MAX(session_start) AS last_session_start,
        SUM(session_no) AS total_session_no,
        ROUND(SUM(events) / NULLIF(SUM(duration_min), 0), 3) AS events_to_duration_min_ratio,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(pay_status)) AS pay_status_list
    FROM per_session
    WHERE events >= 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
    HAVING SUM(events) > 2
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    session_end_month,
    events,
    last_session_start,
    total_session_no,
    pay_status_list,
    ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(last_session_start) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(session_end_month)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_session_end_month_to_last_session_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', session_start_month) AS session_start_month_quarter
FROM rollup_base
ORDER BY session_end_month DESC NULLS FIRST, events DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_tour_packages = (
    df_tour_packages
    .filter(F.col("tour_operator_no") <= 31)
    .select(
        "id",
        "tour_operator_no",
        "pay_status",
        "review_likes",
        "reserved_ts",
        "flag_is_private",
        F.abs(F.col("review_likes") - 171).alias("review_likes_distance"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_tour_packages.withColumn("prev_reserved_ts", F.lag("reserved_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("pay_status").orderBy("reserved_ts", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_reserved_ts").isNull() | (F.col("reserved_ts") > F.col("prev_reserved_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("pay_status").orderBy("reserved_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("pay_status", "session_no")
    .agg(
        F.min("reserved_ts").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("reserved_ts").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),

    per_session
    .filter(F.col("events") >= 2)
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("month", "session_end").alias("session_end_month"),
        F.date_trunc("month", "session_start").alias("session_start_month"),
        "events",
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("session_start").alias("last_session_start"),
        F.sum("session_no").alias("total_session_no"),
        F.round(F.sum("events") / F.nullif(F.sum("duration_min"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("events_to_duration_min_ratio"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("pay_status")).alias("pay_status_list"),
        F.sum("events").alias("sum_events_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sum_events_check") > 2)
    .drop("sum_events_check")
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .select(
        "session_end_month",
        "events",
        "last_session_start",
        "total_session_no",
        "pay_status_list",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("last_session_start")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("session_end_month"))) / 3600, 1).alias("hours_session_end_month_to_last_session_start"),
        F.date_trunc("quarter", F.col("session_start_month")).alias("session_start_month_quarter"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("session_end_month").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("events").desc_nulls_first(),
```

```sql
    SELECT

        a.alpha_berth,

    GROUP BY a.id, a.alpha_berth, a.biome_span
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        alpha_berth,
        biome_span,
        regional_brigade,

        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d ORDER BY regional_brigade) AS prior_qty_1d_dense_rank,
        LAG(prior_rows_1d) OVER w_prior_rows_1d_by_prior_qty_1_3 AS prev_prior_rows_1d,
        LAG(biome_span) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d ORDER BY regional_brigade, id) AS prev_moved_at
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_prior_rows_1d_by_prior_qty_1_3 AS (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d ORDER BY regional_brigade, id)
)

    biome_span,
    regional_brigade,
    rows_in_sku_id,

    prev_moved_at,
    ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(biome_span) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_moved_at)) / 60, 1) AS minutes_prev_moved_at_to_moved_at,

FROM sequenced
ORDER BY id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_windmills.alias("a")
    .join(

        & (F.col("b.biome_span") < F.col("a.biome_span"))
        & (F.col("b.biome_span") >= F.col("a.biome_span") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
```

```sql
    WHERE s.move_count = g.max_move_count

joined AS (
```

```sql
),
tagged AS (
    -- Derive helper columns

labeled AS (

    FROM labeled
    WHERE sku_unit_cost > (SELECT AVG(sku_unit_cost) FROM labeled)
)
SELECT
    id,
    operator,
    unit_price_distance,
    move_move_type_count,
    warehouse_opened_on,
    sku_unit_cost,
```

```python
    df_stock_moves

)
```

```python
w_artist_id_is_explicit = Window.partitionBy("artist_id", "is_explicit")
w_is_explicit_label_by_bpm = Window.partitionBy("is_explicit_label").orderBy("bpm", "id")
w_artist_id = Window.partitionBy("artist_id")
ranked = (

    .select(

        "artist_id",
        "duration_sec",
        "is_explicit",
        "bpm",

        F.lead("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", "is_explicit").orderBy("bpm", "id")).alias("next_duration_sec"),
        F.round(F.col("duration_sec") - F.avg("duration_sec").over(w_artist_id_is_explicit), 2).alias("duration_sec_vs_artist_id_is_explicit_avg"),

        F.first("bpm").over(Window.orderBy("bpm", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_bpm"),
        F.lead("duration_sec", 3).over(Window.orderBy("bpm", "id")).alias("next3_duration_sec"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("rows_in_artist_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("bpm").over(w_artist_id_is_explicit), 2).alias("artist_id_is_explicit_avg_bpm"),
        F.last("duration_sec_filled").over(Window.partitionBy("is_explicit", "is_explicit_label").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_filled").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_duration_sec_filled"),
        F.nth_value("duration_sec_filled", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("is_explicit_label").orderBy("bpm", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_duration_sec_filled"),
```

```sql
        bid_ts_hour,
        bid_state_cur_or_unknown,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_bids = (
    df_bids
    .select(
        "id",
        "commodity_lot_id",
        "bid_state_cur",
        "moisture_percent",
        "bid_ts",
        "flag_is_certified",
        F.when(F.col("commodity").isin("coffee", "rubber"), "group_a").when(F.col("commodity") == "palm_oil", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("commodity_group"),
        F.hour(F.col("bid_ts")).alias("bid_ts_hour"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("bid_state_cur"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("bid_state_cur_or_unknown"),
    )
)

commodity_lot_id_stats = (
    base_bids
    .groupBy("commodity_lot_id")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("bid_ts_hour", 0.5).alias("median_bid_ts_hour"))
)

compared = (
    base_bids.alias("s")
    .join(commodity_lot_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.commodity_lot_id") == F.col("s.commodity_lot_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.bid_ts_hour") >= F.col("g.median_bid_ts_hour"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.median_bid_ts_hour",
        F.round(F.col("s.bid_ts_hour") - F.col("g.median_bid_ts_hour"), 2).alias("bid_ts_hour_minus_median"),
    )
)

combined_details = (
    compared.alias("s")
    .join(df_commodity_lots.alias("c"), F.col("c.id") == F.col("s.commodity_lot_id"), "left")
    .join(df_trading_posts.alias("t"), F.col("t.id") == F.col("c.trading_post_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.commodity_lot_id",
        "s.moisture_percent",
        "s.bid_ts",
        "s.commodity_group",
        "s.bid_ts_hour",
        "s.bid_state_cur_or_unknown",
        F.col("c.tick_volume").alias("commodity_lot_tick_volume"),
        F.col("c.flag_is_certified").alias("commodity_lot_flag_is_certified"),
        F.col("c.bid_at").alias("commodity_lot_bid_at"),
        F.col("t.lot_listed_date").alias("trading_post_lot_listed_date"),
        F.col("t.lot_grade_no").alias("trading_post_lot_grade_no"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    combined_details
    .select(
        "*",
        F.size(F.collect_set("commodity_lot_id").over(Window.partitionBy("trading_post_lot_grade_no", "bid_state_cur_or_unknown"))).alias("distinct_commodity_lot_id_in_trading_post_lot_gr"),
        F.last("bid_ts", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("bid_state_cur_or_unknown").orderBy(F.col("commodity_lot_tick_volume").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_bid_ts"),
        F.round(F.col("commodity_lot_tick_volume") / F.nullif(F.sum("commodity_lot_tick_volume").over(Window.partitionBy("trading_post_lot_grade_no", "bid_state_cur_or_unknown")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("commodity_lot_tick_volume_share_of_trading_post_"),
        F.last("trading_post_lot_listed_date", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("bid_state_cur_or_unknown").orderBy(F.col("commodity_lot_tick_volume").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_trading_post_lot_listed_date"),
    )
)

commodity_group_stats = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("commodity_group")
    .agg(F.avg("commodity_lot_tick_volume").alias("avg_commodity_lot_tick_volume"))
)

vs_group = (
    with_windows.alias("s")
    .join(commodity_group_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.commodity_group") == F.col("s.commodity_group"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.commodity_lot_tick_volume") > F.col("g.avg_commodity_lot_tick_volume"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_commodity_lot_tick_volume",
        F.round(F.col("s.commodity_lot_tick_volume") - F.col("g.avg_commodity_lot_tick_volume"), 2).alias("commodity_lot_tick_volume_minus_avg"),
    )
)

with_activity = (
    vs_group.alias("s")
    .join(df_price_ticks.alias("p"), (F.col("p.commodity_lot_ref") == F.col("s.commodity_lot_id")) & (F.col("p.moisture_pct") >= 12.6) & (F.col("p.lot_tonnes") < 370.0), "left_anti")
)

deduped = (
    with_activity
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("commodity_group").orderBy(F.col("avg_commodity_lot_tick_volume").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "commodity_lot_id",
        "moisture_percent",
        "bid_ts",
        "commodity_group",
        "commodity_lot_tick_volume",
        "commodity_lot_flag_is_certified",
        "trading_post_lot_listed_date",
        "trading_post_lot_grade_no",
        "distinct_commodity_lot_id_in_trading_post_lot_gr",
        "commodity_lot_tick_volume_share_of_trading_post_",
        "last_known_trading_post_lot_listed_date",
        "commodity_lot_tick_volume_minus_avg",
        F.when(F.col("bid_state_cur_or_unknown").isin("open", "won"), "group_a").when(F.col("bid_state_cur_or_unknown") == "UNKNOWN", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("bid_state_cur_or_unknown_group"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("commodity_lot_tick_volume_minus_avg").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("commodity_group").desc(),
    )
)
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,

),
stats AS (

        MIN(played_at) AS first_played_at,
        MIN(prior_ms_played_7d) AS min_prior_ms_played_7d,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY listener_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at), prior_rows_7d
)
SELECT
    listener_id,
    played_at_month,
    prior_rows_7d,
    stddev_prior_rows_7d,
    first_played_at,
    min_prior_ms_played_7d,
    cnt,
```

```sql
    JOIN tour_packages t ON t.id = s.tour_package_id
    LEFT JOIN tour_operators tou ON tou.id = t.tour_operator_no
    WHERE t.pay_status NOT IN ('refunded', 'deposit')
),
pay_state_stats AS (
    -- Median max_review_post_deposit_amt per pay_state
    SELECT pay_state, PERCENTILE_APPROX(max_review_post_deposit_amt, 0.5) AS median_max_review_post_deposit_amt
    FROM combined_details_tour_package
    GROUP BY pay_state
),
compared AS (

    FROM combined_details_tour_package s

FROM compared
```

```python
base_review_posts = (
    df_review_posts

        F.when(F.col("pay_state").isin("paid", "deposit"), "group_a").when(F.col("pay_state") == "refunded", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("pay_state_group"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("pay_state")), 1, 4).alias("pay_state_prefix"),

review_post_stats = (
    df_review_posts
    .groupBy("tour_package_id")
    .agg(
        F.sum("deposit_amt").alias("total_review_post_deposit_amt"),
        F.count("*").alias("review_post_count"),
        F.max("deposit_amt").alias("max_review_post_deposit_amt"),

with_counts = (

    .join(review_post_stats.alias("r"), F.col("r.tour_package_id") == F.col("s.tour_package_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "r.total_review_post_deposit_amt",

        "r.max_review_post_deposit_amt",
    )
)

combined_details_tour_package = (

    .join(df_tour_operators.alias("tou"), F.col("tou.id") == F.col("t.tour_operator_no"), "left")
    .filter(~F.col("t.pay_status").isin("refunded", "deposit"))

        "s.tour_package_id",
        "s.pay_state",
        "s.deposit_amt",
        "s.deposit_amt_tier",
        "s.pay_state_group",
        "s.pay_state_prefix",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
```

```sql
    SELECT
```
```sql
        a.id,
```

```sql
    GROUP BY a.id, a.policy_id, a.claim_date
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows that have matching ranches
    SELECT s.*
    FROM in_window s
    WHERE s.policy_id IN (
            SELECT c.policy_id
            FROM ranches c
            WHERE c.claim_date >= DATE '2024-04-15'
        )
)
SELECT
    policy_id,
    prior_rows_30d,
    MIN(claim_date) AS first_claim_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM screened
```

```sql
    b.pack_total_scrap_rate,
    COALESCE(a.assembly_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.pack_count, 0) AS net_count
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.csat) AS prior_csat_12h
    FROM harvester_compasses a
    LEFT JOIN harvester_compasses b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
with_details AS (
    -- Attach agent attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        su.tier AS agent_tier,
        su.agent_name,
        su.team AS summit_bucket
    FROM matched s
    JOIN pine_regattas su ON su.id = s.agent_id
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(opened_at), prior_rows_12h ORDER BY prior_csat_12h DESC) AS prior_csat_12h_rank,
        ROUND(prior_csat_12h - AVG(prior_csat_12h) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id, agent_tier), 2) AS prior_csat_12h_vs_agent_id_agent_tier_avg,
        LAG(prior_csat_12h) OVER (ORDER BY prior_rows_12h DESC, id) AS mantle_flag
    FROM with_details
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach harvester_compasses metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(t.closed_at) FROM harvester_compasses t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS last_ticket_closed_at,
        (SELECT MAX(t.closed_at) FROM harvester_compasses t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS last_ticket_closed_at_2
    FROM windowed s
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    summit_bucket,
    agent_id,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_12h), 2) AS stddev_prior_rows_12h
FROM profiled
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((summit_bucket, agent_id), (summit_bucket), (agent_id))
ORDER BY summit_bucket NULLS LAST, agent_id NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

matched = (
    df_harvester_compasses.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_harvester_compasses.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.agent_id") == F.col("a.agent_id"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") < F.col("a.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.agent_id", "a.opened_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.csat").alias("prior_csat_12h"),
    )
)

with_details = (
    matched.alias("s")
    .join(df_pine_regattas.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("su.tier").alias("agent_tier"),
        "su.agent_name",
        F.col("su.team").alias("summit_bucket"),
    )
)

windowed = (
    with_details
    .select(
        "*",
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("opened_at"), "prior_rows_12h").orderBy(F.col("prior_csat_12h").desc())).alias("prior_csat_12h_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("prior_csat_12h") - F.avg("prior_csat_12h").over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", "agent_tier")), 2).alias("prior_csat_12h_vs_agent_id_agent_tier_avg"),
        F.lag("prior_csat_12h").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("prior_rows_12h").desc(), "id")).alias("mantle_flag"),
    )
)

ticket_stats = (
    df_harvester_compasses
    .groupBy("agent_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("closed_at").alias("last_ticket_closed_at"),
        F.max("closed_at").alias("last_ticket_closed_at_2"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    windowed.alias("s")
    .join(ticket_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.agent_id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "t.last_ticket_closed_at", "t.last_ticket_closed_at_2")
)

result = (
    profiled
    .groupingSets(
        [["summit_bucket", "agent_id"], ["summit_bucket"], ["agent_id"]],
        "summit_bucket", "agent_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.round(F.stddev("prior_rows_12h"), 2).alias("stddev_prior_rows_12h"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("summit_bucket").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("agent_id").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY game_mode ORDER BY round_ended_ts_month, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS raw_burst_id
    FROM flagged

        raw_burst_id,
        MIN(round_ended_ts_month) AS session_start,
        MAX(round_ended_ts_month) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(round_ended_ts_month)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(round_ended_ts_month))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min

screened AS (

    SELECT *
```

```python
    )

with_prev = scoped_game_titles.withColumn("prev_round_ended_ts_month", F.lag("round_ended_ts_month").over(Window.partitionBy("game_mode").orderBy("round_ended_ts_month", "id")))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_tracks = df_tracks.filter(F.col("duration_sec").between(165, 402))

w_artist_id = Window.partitionBy("artist_id")
w_artist_id_release_date_year = Window.partitionBy("artist_id", F.year("release_date")).orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w_all_by_release_date = Window.orderBy(F.col("release_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
ranked = (
    prepared_tracks
    .select(
        "id",
        "title",
        "duration_sec",
        "release_date",
        "is_explicit",
        "moods",

        (F.col("duration_sec") - F.lag("duration_sec").over(w_all_by_release_date)).alias("duration_sec_change"),
        F.round(F.avg("duration_sec").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("release_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)), 2).alias("duration_sec_avg_3_prior"),
        F.max("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("artist_id_max_duration_sec"),
        F.round(F.col("bpm") / F.nullif(F.sum("bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("bpm_share_of_artist_id"),
        F.nth_value("duration_sec", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", F.year("release_date")).orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_duration_sec"),

        F.round(F.col("bpm") - F.avg("bpm").over(w_artist_id), 2).alias("bpm_vs_artist_id_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("rows_in_artist_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id", F.year("release_date")).orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("bpm_avg_4"),
    )
)

labeled = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("rows_in_artist_id"), F.lit(0)).alias("rows_in_artist_id_filled"),
        F.when(F.col("bpm_vs_artist_id_avg") >= 36.0, "HIGH").when(F.col("bpm_vs_artist_id_avg") >= -36.0, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("bpm_vs_artist_id_avg_tier"),
```

```sql
joined_student AS (

        s.term_len,

        st.is_international AS student_is_international,
        st.enrolled_on AS student_enrolled_on,
        c.dept AS course_dept,
        c.credits AS course_credits
    FROM recent s
    JOIN students st ON st.id = s.student_id
    LEFT JOIN courses c ON c.id = s.course_id
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates

        *,

),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        enrolled_at,
        grade_status_term_label,
        term_len,

        course_credits_change,

),
enriched AS (

        s.student_id,

        s.enrolled_at,
        s.grade_status_term_label,
```

```sql
    SELECT sku_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_qty_1d, 0.5) AS median_prior_qty_1d
    FROM joined_ranges
    GROUP BY sku_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_prior_qty_1d,
        ROUND(s.prior_qty_1d - g.median_prior_qty_1d, 2) AS summit_kayak
    FROM joined_ranges s
    JOIN sku_id_stats g ON g.sku_id = s.sku_id
    WHERE s.prior_qty_1d >= g.median_prior_qty_1d
)
SELECT
    id,
    sku_id,
    moved_at,
    prior_rows_1d,
    median_prior_qty_1d,
    ROUND(median_prior_qty_1d / NULLIF(prior_qty_1d, 0), 3) AS median_prior_qty_1d_per_prior_qty_1d,
    prior_qty_1d + prior_rows_1d AS prior_qty_1d_plus_prior_rows_1d
FROM vs_group
ORDER BY median_prior_qty_1d, id
LIMIT 5
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
```

```python
        F.nth_value("bpm", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("is_explicit").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_bpm"),
```

```python
in_window = (
    df_maple_headlands.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_maple_headlands.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_12h"),
    )
)

w_prior_rows_12h_student_id = Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_12h", "student_id")
ranked = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "id",
        "prior_rows_12h",
        "prior_score_12h",
        F.lag("prior_rows_12h").over(w_prior_rows_12h_by_prior_scor).alias("prev_prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("prior_score_12h").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("enrolled_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("prior_score_12h_sum_2_prior"),
```

```sql
ranked AS (
```

```sql
        SUM(prior_rows_1d) OVER (ORDER BY prior_rows_1d DESC NULLS FIRST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS marble_quarrie,

),
site_zone_stats AS (

compared AS (
```

```sql
    FROM cleaned

    HAVING COUNT_IF(host = 'h4') < 1000
```

```python
parsed = (
```

```python
base = (

        "brand",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",
        "golden_wagon",
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "golden_wagon").alias("launch_date_period"),
        F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("brand_filled"),
    )
)

with_windows = (

        "category",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",

        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("category", "brand").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")).alias("seq_no"),

    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("c.last_restock"),
        F.col("c.quantity").alias("inventory_quantity"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    with_latest
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("launch_date_period").over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("launch_date_period", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("launch_date_period") > F.lag("launch_date_period").over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("launch_date_period", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(

        "category",
        "stock_qty",
        "launch_date_period",
        "seq_no",
        "last_restock",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("launch_date_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

filtered = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "stock_qty",
        "seq_no",
        "last_restock",
        "burst_id",
        F.when(F.col("stock_qty") >= 389, "High").when(F.col("stock_qty") >= 193, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("stock_qty_band"),
        F.upper("category").alias("category_upper"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(

    )
    .withColumn("burst_id_per_home_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("seq_no_tier").orderBy(F.col("coastal_tram").desc())))
```

```sql
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        salary,
        is_remote,
        level,
        CAST(is_remote AS INT) AS is_remote_flag,
        CAST(is_remote AS INT) AS is_remote_flag_2
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date > DATE '2023-05-29'
      AND job_title IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'Analyst'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id, manager_id ORDER BY is_remote_flag_2 NULLS LAST) = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(is_remote_flag) OVER w_part AS last4_min_is_remote_flag,
        COUNT(is_remote_flag) OVER w_part AS last4_count_is_remote_flag,
        SUM(is_remote_flag) OVER w_part AS last4_sum_is_remote_flag
    FROM deduped
    WHERE manager_id IN (1, 37)
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.full_name,
        e.dept_id,
        e.manager_id,
        e.salary,
        e.level,
        e.is_remote_flag_2,
        e.last4_min_is_remote_flag,
        e.last4_count_is_remote_flag,
        p.job_title,
        p.level AS employee_level,
        p.salary AS employee_salary
    FROM with_windows e
    LEFT JOIN employees p
        ON e.manager_id <=> p.id
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.full_name,
    s.dept_id,
    s.manager_id,
    s.salary,
    s.level,
    s.last4_min_is_remote_flag,
    s.last4_count_is_remote_flag,
    s.job_title,
    (SELECT SUM(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.manager_id = s.manager_id) AS sum_employee_salary
FROM enriched s
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```sql
    select *, case when lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id) is null
                 or reading_ts > lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id) + interval '15' minute then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from device_readings
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        pressure,
        firmware,
        sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id
    from gaps
),
latest as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *, rank() over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts desc) as row_num
    from islands
    qualify row_num = 1
),
deduped as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from latest
    qualify row_number() over (partition by device_code order by row_num, id) = 1
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        row_num,
        count(pressure) over (partition by device_code order by session_id, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_count_pressure,
        max(pressure) over (partition by device_code order by session_id, id rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_max_pressure,

    from deduped
    where firmware not in ('1.0.3', '2.0.1')
)
select
    id,
    row_num,
    last3_count_pressure,
    last3_max_pressure,
```

```sql
        read_at,
        northern_scaffold,
        prior_voltage_12h
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY holster_level ORDER BY northern_scaffold DESC, id DESC) AS recency_rank
        FROM covered
    ) ranked
    WHERE recency_rank = 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    holster_level,
    read_at,
    northern_scaffold,
    prior_voltage_12h,
```

```python
    .withColumn("next_units_built", F.lead("units_built").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w_grp))

valid = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("started_on") >= F.lit("2023-03-08").cast("date")) & F.col("order_priority").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
```

```python
cleaned = (
    df_ticket_events
    .select(
        "id",

        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.coalesce(F.col("event_type"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("event_type_or_unknown_final"),
        F.when(F.col("actor").isin("agent", "customer"), "group_a").when(F.col("actor") == "system", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("actor_group"),
    )
)

w_ticket_id_by_event_at_2 = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy("event_at", "id")
w_actor_group_event_type_by_ev = Window.partitionBy("actor_group", "event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")
ranked = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("event_at") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc(), "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_event_at"),
        F.lead("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("actor_group", "event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")).alias("next_event_at"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_ticket_id_by_event_at_2).alias("event_at_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_actor_group_event_type_by_ev).alias("event_at_dense_rank_2"),
        F.last("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("actor").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_event_at"),

        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy(F.col("event_at").desc())), 3).alias("event_at_cume_dist"),
        F.last("event_at", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_id").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_event_at"),
        F.lag("event_at").over(w_ticket_id_by_event_at_2).alias("prev_event_at"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_actor_group_event_type_by_ev), 3).alias("event_at_cume_dist_3"),
    )
)

w_ticket_id_actor = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "actor")
ranked_2 = (
    ranked

        F.first("last_event_at", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_event_at")).orderBy(F.col("last_known_event_at").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_last_event_at"),

    )
)

    ranked_2
    .select(

        "ticket_id",
        "event_type",
```

```sql
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,

        SUM(kwh) AS session_kwh,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY site_id, burst_id
)
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_3d
    FROM banners a
    LEFT JOIN banners b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT *, COALESCE(prior_rows_3d, 0) AS actuator_qty
    FROM in_window
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(prior_ms_played_3d / NULLIF(SUM(prior_ms_played_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id, prior_rows_3d), 0), 4) AS prior_ms_played_3d_share_of_listener_id_prior_ro,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id, prior_rows_3d) AS rows_in_listener_id_prior_rows_3d
    FROM annotated
)
SELECT id, metric_name, reading
FROM (
    SELECT id, prior_rows_3d, prior_ms_played_3d
    FROM metrics
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric_name IN (prior_rows_3d, prior_ms_played_3d)
) unp
ORDER BY id, metric_name
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_banners.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_banners.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.listener_id") == F.col("a.listener_id"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_3d"),
    )
)

annotated = in_window.withColumn("actuator_qty", F.coalesce(F.col("prior_rows_3d"), F.lit(0)))

metrics = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("prior_ms_played_3d") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_ms_played_3d").over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id", "prior_rows_3d")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prior_ms_played_3d_share_of_listener_id_prior_ro"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id", "prior_rows_3d")).alias("rows_in_listener_id_prior_rows_3d"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select("id", "prior_rows_3d", "prior_ms_played_3d")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["prior_rows_3d", "prior_ms_played_3d"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading").isNotNull())
    .orderBy("id", "metric_name")
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_galleries
    .select(

    )
)
```

```sql
WITH matched AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.warehouse_tally,
        a.hermitage_flag,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.csat) AS prior_csat_3d
    FROM estate_almanacs a
    LEFT JOIN estate_almanacs b
      ON b.warehouse_tally = a.warehouse_tally
     AND b.hermitage_flag < a.hermitage_flag
     AND b.hermitage_flag >= a.hermitage_flag - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.warehouse_tally, a.hermitage_flag
),
annotated AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_tally,
        prior_csat_3d,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hermitage_flag) AS marble_envoy,
        CASE WHEN prior_rows_3d >= 6 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN prior_rows_3d >= 3 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prior_rows_3d_tier
    FROM matched
),
agent_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_csat_3d per warehouse_tally
    SELECT warehouse_tally, AVG(prior_csat_3d) AS avg_prior_csat_3d
    FROM annotated
    GROUP BY warehouse_tally
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_csat_3d,
        ROUND(s.prior_csat_3d - g.avg_prior_csat_3d, 2) AS prior_csat_3d_minus_avg
    FROM annotated s
    JOIN agent_id_stats g ON g.warehouse_tally = s.warehouse_tally
    WHERE s.prior_csat_3d > g.avg_prior_csat_3d
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    warehouse_tally,
    prior_csat_3d,
    marble_envoy,
    prior_rows_3d_tier,
    prior_csat_3d_minus_avg
FROM vs_group
ORDER BY prior_rows_3d_tier DESC, id
LIMIT 5
```

```python
matched = (
    df_estate_almanacs.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_estate_almanacs.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.warehouse_tally") == F.col("a.warehouse_tally"))
        & (F.col("b.hermitage_flag") < F.col("a.hermitage_flag"))
        & (F.col("b.hermitage_flag") >= F.col("a.hermitage_flag") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.warehouse_tally", "a.hermitage_flag")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
```

```python
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        F.concat_ws(" / ", F.col("event_type"), F.col("actor")).alias("event_type_actor_label"),
```

```sql
    FROM valid
```

```sql
),
with_activity AS (

    FROM windowed s
    WHERE EXISTS (

            WHERE c.campus_id = s.campus_id

),
campus_id_stats AS (
    -- Median lesson_minutes_percent_rank per campus_id
    SELECT campus_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(lesson_minutes_percent_rank, 0.5) AS median_lesson_minutes_percent_rank
    FROM with_activity

),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_lesson_minutes_percent_rank,
        ROUND(s.lesson_minutes_percent_rank - g.median_lesson_minutes_percent_rank, 2) AS lesson_minutes_percent_rank_minus_median
    FROM with_activity s
    JOIN campus_id_stats g ON g.campus_id = s.campus_id
    WHERE s.lesson_minutes_percent_rank >= g.median_lesson_minutes_percent_rank
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    club_codes_count,
    campus_id,
    ROUND(SUM(median_lesson_minutes_percent_rank), 2) AS total_median_lesson_minutes_percent_rank,
    ROUND(SUM(median_lesson_minutes_percent_rank) / NULLIF(SUM(lesson_minutes_percent_rank), 0), 3) AS median_lesson_minutes_percent_rank_to_lesson_min,
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```sql
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at_hi)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at_hi))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

)

FROM (
    SELECT burst_id, event_count, actor, duration_min
    FROM sessions
) src
PIVOT (
    MIN(duration_min)

)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared = (
    df_raw_bakeries

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("harvest_grade_group", "harvest_grade").orderBy(F.col("harvested_on").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
```

```sql
sessionized AS (
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY score_tier ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id

per_session AS (

        SUM(score) AS session_score,

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY score_tier, session_id
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(n_events - AVG(n_events) OVER w_session_id, 2) AS n_events_vs_session_id_avg,
        NTH_VALUE(n_events, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY score_tier, YEAR(session_start) ORDER BY session_start, score_tier, session_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_n_events
    FROM per_session
    WINDOW w_session_id AS (PARTITION BY session_id)
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        session_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT score_tier) AS distinct_score_tiers,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(duration_min, 0.5) AS median_duration_min,
        ROUND(STDDEV(duration_min), 2) AS stddev_duration_min,
        SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min,
        MAX(session_end) AS last_session_end
    FROM windowed
    GROUP BY session_id
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT session_id, metric_name, metric_value

    FROM grouped
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_enrollments = (
    df_enrollments
    .filter(F.col("enrolled_at") < F.lit("2025-03-08 14:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.when(F.col("score") >= 78.8, "HIGH").when(F.col("score") >= 38.1, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("score_tier"),
    )
)

with_prev = valid_enrollments.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("score_tier").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("enrolled_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_enrolled_at")) / 60 > 90), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("score_tier").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (

        F.max("enrolled_at").alias("session_end"),

        F.sum("score").alias("session_score"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("enrolled_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("enrolled_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),

windowed = (
    per_session

    .withColumn("second_n_events", F.nth_value("n_events", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("score_tier", F.year("session_start")).orderBy("session_start", "score_tier", "session_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)))
)

        F.sum("duration_min").alias("total_duration_min"),
        F.max("session_end").alias("last_session_end"),
    )
)

result = (
```

```sql
        approved_amount - LAG(approved_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(claim_date) ORDER BY premium, id) AS approved_amount_change
    FROM filtered
),
status_stats AS (

outliers AS (
```

```sql
WITH joined_ranges AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.csat) AS prior_csat_3d
    FROM river_dairies a
    LEFT JOIN river_dairies b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        prior_rows_3d,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_at) AS opened_at_month,
        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_3d), 2) AS crimson_array,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
    FROM joined_ranges
    GROUP BY prior_rows_3d, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_at)
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    prior_rows_3d,
    distinct_ids,
    MAX(opened_at_month) AS pine_cultivar,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM rollup_base
GROUP BY CUBE(prior_rows_3d, distinct_ids)
ORDER BY prior_rows_3d NULLS LAST, distinct_ids NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

joined_ranges = (
    df_river_dairies.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_river_dairies.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.agent_id") == F.col("a.agent_id"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") < F.col("a.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.agent_id", "a.opened_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.csat").alias("prior_csat_3d"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    joined_ranges
    .groupBy(
        "prior_rows_3d",
        F.date_trunc("month", "opened_at").alias("opened_at_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("prior_rows_3d"), 2).alias("crimson_array"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .cube("prior_rows_3d", "distinct_ids")
    .agg(
```

```sql
    GROUP BY a.id, a.robot_rank, a.read_at

reading_stats AS (
    -- Per-site engine_benches metrics
    SELECT
        robot_rank,
        MAX(read_at) AS crimson_canal,
        MIN(read_at) AS first_reading_read_at
    FROM engine_benches
    GROUP BY robot_rank
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach engine_benches metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        m.crimson_canal,
        m.first_reading_read_at
    FROM covered s
    LEFT JOIN reading_stats m ON m.robot_rank = s.robot_rank
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        robot_rank,
        read_at,
        prior_rows_12h,
        prior_voltage_12h,
        crimson_canal,
        first_reading_read_at,
        MAX(prior_voltage_12h) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(crimson_canal), YEAR(first_reading_read_at) ORDER BY first_reading_read_at DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_prior_voltage_12h_so_far,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(first_reading_read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(first_reading_read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(crimson_canal), YEAR(first_reading_read_at) ORDER BY first_reading_read_at DESC, id))) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_first_reading_read_at,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(read_at) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(crimson_canal), YEAR(first_reading_read_at) ORDER BY first_reading_read_at DESC, id))) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_read_at,
        ROUND(AVG(prior_voltage_12h) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_12h, robot_rank), 2) AS ivory_mantle
    FROM with_counts
),
site_id_stats AS (
    -- Max prior_voltage_12h per robot_rank
    SELECT robot_rank, MAX(prior_voltage_12h) AS max_prior_voltage_12h
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY robot_rank
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_prior_voltage_12h,

    FROM ranked s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.robot_rank = s.robot_rank
    WHERE s.prior_voltage_12h = g.max_prior_voltage_12h

    prior_voltage_12h_minus_max,
```

```sql
    -- void rows per table_ticket_id
    SELECT table_ticket_id, COUNT(*) AS void_count, SUM(tip_amount) AS void_total_tip_amount
    FROM ticket_lines
    WHERE ticket_status = 'void'
    GROUP BY table_ticket_id

    FROM ticket_lines
    WHERE ticket_status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY table_ticket_id
)

SELECT

    COALESCE(a.void_count, 0) AS void_count,
    a.void_total_tip_amount,
    COALESCE(b.paid_count, 0) AS paid_count,
    b.paid_total_tip_amount,
    COALESCE(a.void_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.paid_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM void_by_table_ticket a
FULL OUTER JOIN paid_by_table_ticket b
  ON a.table_ticket_id = b.table_ticket_id
ORDER BY table_ticket_id
```

```sql
    SELECT
```
```sql
        a.id,
```
```sql
        a.site_id,

),
```
```sql
tagged AS (
```
```sql
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
```

```sql
        CASE WHEN prior_voltage_1d >= 980.0 THEN 'A' WHEN prior_voltage_1d >= 490.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS rural_reactor
    FROM matched
    WHERE site_id <= 3
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT read_at, prior_rows_1d, rural_reactor, prior_voltage_1d_adj
    FROM tagged
) src
PIVOT (
    COUNT(prior_voltage_1d_adj)
    FOR rural_reactor IN ('B', 'C')
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

matched = (
    df_junctions.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_junctions.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") < F.col("a.read_at"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.voltage").alias("prior_voltage_1d"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    matched
    .filter(F.col("site_id") <= 3)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("prior_voltage_1d") * 1.5, 2).alias("prior_voltage_1d_adj"),
        F.when(F.col("prior_voltage_1d") >= 980.0, "A").when(F.col("prior_voltage_1d") >= 490.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("rural_reactor"),
    )
)

result = (
    tagged
    .groupBy("read_at", "prior_rows_1d")
    .pivot("rural_reactor", ["B", "C"])
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.crane_ts,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_7d,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_7d
    FROM golden_cathedrals a
    LEFT JOIN golden_cathedrals b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.crane_ts < a.crane_ts
     AND b.crane_ts >= a.crane_ts - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.crane_ts
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(prior_rows_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d ORDER BY prior_ms_played_7d DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_prior_rows_7d,
        MAX(prior_ms_played_7d) OVER w_listener_id AS maple_skiff,
        MIN(prior_ms_played_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id) AS listener_id_min_prior_ms_played_7d,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_7d ORDER BY prior_ms_played_7d DESC), 3) AS prior_ms_played_7d_cume_dist,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_listener_id AS granite_cascade
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_listener_id AS (PARTITION BY listener_id)
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    listener_id,
    prior_rows_7d,
    SUM(prior_rows_7d) AS total_prior_rows_7d,
    MAX(crane_ts) AS last_played_at
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CUBE(listener_id, prior_rows_7d)
ORDER BY listener_id NULLS LAST, prior_rows_7d NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_golden_cathedrals.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_golden_cathedrals.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.listener_id") == F.col("a.listener_id"))
        & (F.col("b.crane_ts") < F.col("a.crane_ts"))
        & (F.col("b.crane_ts") >= F.col("a.crane_ts") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.crane_ts")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_7d"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_7d"),
    )
)

w_listener_id = Window.partitionBy("listener_id")
with_windows = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("prior_rows_7d").over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_7d").orderBy(F.col("prior_ms_played_7d").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_prior_rows_7d"),
        F.max("prior_ms_played_7d").over(w_listener_id).alias("maple_skiff"),
        F.min("prior_ms_played_7d").over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id")).alias("listener_id_min_prior_ms_played_7d"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_7d").orderBy(F.col("prior_ms_played_7d").desc())), 3).alias("prior_ms_played_7d_cume_dist"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_listener_id).alias("granite_cascade"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .cube("listener_id", "prior_rows_7d")
    .agg(
        F.sum("prior_rows_7d").alias("total_prior_rows_7d"),
        F.max("crane_ts").alias("last_played_at"),
    )

        F.col("prior_rows_7d").asc_nulls_last(),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    base_moves
    .groupBy("move_type")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("qty", 0.5).alias("median_qty"))
)

vs_group = (
    base_moves.alias("s")
    .join(move_type_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.move_type") == F.col("s.move_type"), "inner")

    )
)

with_trends = (
    vs_group
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("median_qty", 1, 0).over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id").orderBy(F.col("median_qty").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("next_median_qty"),
        F.lead("unit_price").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_median").desc(), "id")).alias("next_unit_price"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id").orderBy(F.col("median_qty").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_median").desc())).alias("maple_clamp"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_trends.alias("s")
    .join(df_coral_shutters.alias("w"), F.col("w.id") == F.col("s.warehouse_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.warehouse_id",

        "s.move_type",
        "s.moved_at",
        "s.operator",
        "s.median_qty",
        "s.qty_minus_median",
        "s.running_count",
        "s.maple_clamp",
        F.col("w.opened_on").alias("warehouse_opened_on"),
        F.col("w.city").alias("warehouse_city"),
    )
)

derived = enriched.withColumn("tablet_ts", F.col("moved_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS"))

top_rows = (
    derived
    .filter(F.col("maple_clamp") == 1)
    .drop("maple_clamp")
)

ranked = (

    .select(

        "sku_id",

        "median_qty",
        "qty_minus_median",
        "running_count",
        "warehouse_opened_on",

        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("median_qty").desc(), "id")).alias("median_qty_seq"),

    )
)

result = (

    .select(

        "sku_id",
        "qty_minus_median",
        "warehouse_opened_on",
        "tablet_ts",
        "dashboard_code",
        "seq_no",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("amount", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("discount_pct", "id", "promo_id", "subscription_id")

cleaned = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("store_id").isin([20, 34, 36]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        F.col("shipping_fee").cast("int").alias("shipping_fee_int"),
        (F.col("amount") * F.col("discount")).alias("amount_times_discount"),
    )
)

matched = (
    cleaned
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("a.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("a.order_date") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("a.order_date") < F.col("pr.ends_on") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    matched
    .withColumn("running_count_discount_pct", F.count("discount_pct").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_avg_discount_pct", F.avg("discount_pct").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_min_discount_pct", F.min("discount_pct").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("next_shipping_fee_int", F.lead("shipping_fee_int", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("store_id", "promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id", "promo_id")))
)

matched_orders = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("src.order_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("src.order_date") <= F.date_add(F.col("sub.end_date"), 7)), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

cleaned_orders = (
    matched_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-07-17").cast("date")) & (F.col("status") == "COMPLETED"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("amount_times_discount") >= 88, "High").when(F.col("amount_times_discount") >= 30, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("amount_times_discount_tier"),
        F.coalesce("promo_code", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("promo_code_filled"),
    )
)

    cleaned_orders
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("shipping_fee_int").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("amount_times_discount", "id", "promo_id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("cumulative_shipping_fee_int"),
        F.lead("amount", 1).over(w_ordered).alias("next_amount"),
        F.round((F.col("subscription_id") / F.sum("subscription_id").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("order_date"), "status"))), 4).alias("subscription_id_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "order_date").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED", F.col("amount_times_discount"))).alias("completed_total_amount_times_discount"),
        F.round(F.sum("running_avg_discount_pct") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "premium", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_avg_discount_pct_per_premium"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", 1)).alias("enterprise_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", F.col("next_amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("enterprise_next_amount"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", F.col("cumulative_shipping_fee_int"))).alias("mobile_max_cumulative_shipping_fee_int"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("enterprise_rows") > 1)
)
```

```python
        F.concat_ws("-", F.col("event_type"), F.col("actor")).alias("event_type_actor_label"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("event_at")).alias("days_since_event_at_2"),
    )
)

    recent
    .withColumn("recency_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("event_type", "ticket_id").orderBy("days_since_event_at_2", "id")))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_plays = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("device").isin("phone", "tv", "speaker"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "listener_id",
        "track_id",
        "played_at",

        "is_skipped",
        F.date_trunc("year", F.col("played_at")).alias("played_at_year"),
    )
)

with_parent_listener = (
    scoped_plays.alias("s")
    .join(df_listeners.alias("l"), F.col("l.id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.listener_id",
        "s.track_id",
        "s.played_at",
        "s.ms_played",
        "s.device",
        "s.is_skipped",
        "s.played_at_year",
        F.col("l.birth_year").alias("listener_birth_year"),
        F.col("l.signup_date").alias("listener_signup_date"),
    )
)

w_played_at_year_by_played_at = Window.partitionBy(F.year("played_at")).orderBy("played_at", "id")
w_track_id_is_skipped = Window.partitionBy("track_id", "is_skipped")

ranked = (
    with_parent_listener
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("played_at_year").over(w_played_at_year_by_played_at).alias("next_played_at_year"),
        F.round(F.col("listener_birth_year") / F.nullif(F.sum("listener_birth_year").over(w_track_id_is_skipped), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("listener_birth_year_share_of_track_id_is_skipped"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_played_at_year_month_track_i), 3).alias("ms_played_percent_rank"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id", "is_skipped")).alias("rows_in_listener_id_is_skipped"),
        F.row_number().over(w_played_at_year_by_played_at).alias("played_at_seq"),
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id").orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id")).alias("ms_played_quintile"),
        F.lead("listener_birth_year", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id").orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id")).alias("next2_listener_birth_year"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id").orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id")), 3).alias("ms_played_percent_rank_2"),
        F.last("played_at_year", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("played_at")).orderBy("played_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_played_at_year"),
        F.lag("ms_played", 2).over(Window.orderBy("played_at", "id")).alias("prev2_ms_played"),
        F.sum("listener_birth_year").over(w_track_id_is_skipped).alias("track_id_is_skipped_sum_listener_birth_year"),
        F.round(F.col("listener_birth_year") - F.avg("listener_birth_year").over(Window.partitionBy("track_id", "is_skipped")), 2).alias("listener_birth_year_vs_track_id_is_skipped_avg"),
        F.last("played_at_year", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("listener_id").orderBy(F.col("ms_played").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_played_at_year_2"),
    )
)

leaders = ranked.filter(F.col("played_at_seq") <= 5)

w_last_known_played_at_year_2 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("last_known_played_at_year_2"))
metrics = (
    leaders
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("ms_played_quintile").over(w_last_known_played_at_year_2).alias("last_known_played_at_year_2_to_date_min_ms_playe"),
        F.nth_value("ms_played_percent_rank_2", 2).over(Window.orderBy("played_at_year", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_ms_played_percent_rank_2"),

        F.first("ms_played_quintile").over(Window.orderBy("played_at_year", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_ms_played_quintile"),
    )

summary = (

    .groupBy("played_at_seq")
    .agg(

        F.round(F.avg("prev2_ms_played"), 2).alias("avg_prev2_ms_played"),
        F.avg("prev2_ms_played").alias("avg_prev2_ms_played_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_prev2_ms_played_check") > 71476)
    .drop("avg_prev2_ms_played_check")
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "played_at_seq",
        "min_ms_played_percent_rank_2",
        "avg_prev2_ms_played",
        F.when(F.col("played_at_seq") >= 7, "HIGH").when(F.col("played_at_seq") >= 3, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("played_at_seq_tier"),
    )

)
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY lab_site_no ORDER BY run_started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id

qualified AS (
```

```python
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.ceil("amount").alias("amount_whole"),
        F.length("status").alias("status_length"),
    )

with_prev = valid.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")))

    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

        "method",

        "status",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid_plays = (
    df_plays
    .filter((F.col("played_at") >= F.lit("2025-01-25 10:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("device") != "desktop"))

        "is_skipped",

        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("device")), " ", "_")).alias("device_slug"),
    )
)

    valid_plays
    .groupBy("source")
    .agg(F.avg("ms_played").alias("avg_ms_played"))
)

outliers = (
    valid_plays.alias("s")
    .join(source_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.source") == F.col("s.source"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.ms_played") > F.col("g.avg_ms_played"))
    .select(

        "g.avg_ms_played",
        F.round(F.col("s.ms_played") - F.col("g.avg_ms_played"), 2).alias("ms_played_minus_avg"),

        F.lead("ms_played_minus_avg", 2).over(Window.orderBy("avg_ms_played", "id")).alias("next2_ms_played_minus_avg"),

    )
)
```

```sql
    SELECT
```
```sql
        *,
```

```sql
    FROM grouped
    WHERE min_unit_price_orig BETWEEN 25.9 AND 450.1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(moved_at_day) OVER (PARTITION BY cnt_tier ORDER BY n_move_type_adjust DESC, moved_at_day) AS prev_moved_at_day,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cnt_tier ORDER BY n_move_type_adjust DESC) AS n_move_type_adjust_dense_rank,
        DATEDIFF(moved_at_day, LAG(moved_at_day) OVER (PARTITION BY cnt_tier ORDER BY n_move_type_adjust DESC, moved_at_day)) AS days_since_prev_moved_at_day,
        MIN(moved_at_day_year) OVER w_n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan AS n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan_o_moved_at_day_year,
        SUM(moved_at_day_year) OVER (PARTITION BY n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan_o, moved_at_day_year) AS n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan_o_moved_at_day_year_2

SELECT

    moved_at_day_year,
    SUM(n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan_o) AS total_n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan_o,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cnt_tier) AS distinct_cnt_tiers
FROM metrics
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((cnt_tier, moved_at_day_year), (cnt_tier), (moved_at_day_year))
```

```python
prepared_moves = (
    df_stg_boilers
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",
        "sku_id",
        "move_type",
        "moved_at",
        "operator",
        "unit_price_orig",
    )
)

grouped = (
    prepared_moves
    .groupBy(F.to_date("moved_at").alias("moved_at_day"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("operator").isin("op_bee", "op_chan", "op_eve"), 1)).alias("n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan_o"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("operator").isNotNull(), F.col("unit_price_orig")).otherwise(0)).alias("unit_price_orig_operator_is_not_null"),
        F.max("moved_at").alias("last_moved_at"),
        F.min("unit_price_orig").alias("min_unit_price_orig"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("move_type") == "ADJUST", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_move_type_adjust"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    grouped
    .filter(F.col("min_unit_price_orig").between(25.9, 450.1))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("cnt") >= 10, "HIGH").when(F.col("cnt") >= 6, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("cnt_tier"),
        F.year(F.col("moved_at_day")).alias("moved_at_day_year"),

metrics = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("moved_at_day").over(Window.partitionBy("cnt_tier").orderBy(F.col("n_move_type_adjust").desc(), "moved_at_day")).alias("prev_moved_at_day"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("cnt_tier").orderBy(F.col("n_move_type_adjust").desc())).alias("n_move_type_adjust_dense_rank"),
        F.datediff(F.col("moved_at_day"), F.lag("moved_at_day").over(Window.partitionBy("cnt_tier").orderBy(F.col("n_move_type_adjust").desc(), "moved_at_day"))).alias("days_since_prev_moved_at_day"),
        F.min("moved_at_day_year").over(w_n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan).alias("n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan_o_moved_at_day_year"),
        F.sum("moved_at_day_year").over(Window.partitionBy("n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan_o", "moved_at_day_year")).alias("n_operator_in_op_bee_op_chan_o_moved_at_day_year_2"),
    )
)

result = (

    .groupingSets(
        [["cnt_tier", "moved_at_day_year"], ["cnt_tier"], ["moved_at_day_year"]],
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,

    FROM ochre_gorges a

     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
per_group AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(played_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS regional_crossing,
        listener_id,
        SUM(prior_ms_played_12h) AS total_prior_ms_played_12h,
        COUNT(*) AS tram_score,
        COUNT(DISTINCT listener_id) AS distinct_listener_ids,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        ROUND(AVG(pavilion_span), 2) AS avg_prior_rows_12h
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(played_at, 'yyyy-MM'), listener_id
)
SELECT
    regional_crossing,
    total_prior_ms_played_12h,
    tram_score,
    distinct_listener_ids,
    distinct_ids,
    avg_prior_rows_12h
FROM per_group
```

```python
    df_ochre_gorges.alias("a")

    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
```
