    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.scaffold_mark,
        a.moved_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_1d,
        SUM(b.unit_price) AS global_lathe
    FROM spindles a
    LEFT JOIN spindles b
      ON b.scaffold_mark = a.scaffold_mark
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.scaffold_mark, a.moved_at
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        global_lathe + prior_rows_1d AS crystal_qty
    FROM matched
)

    id,
    moved_at,
    global_lathe,
    crystal_qty
FROM scored
ORDER BY crystal_qty NULLS LAST
```

matched = (
    df_spindles.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_spindles.alias("b"),

        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),

        & (F.col("b.opened_at") >= F.col("a.opened_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_looms.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_looms.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.bracelet_span") == F.col("a.bracelet_span"))
        & (F.col("b.plateau_tally") < F.col("a.plateau_tally"))
        & (F.col("b.plateau_tally") >= F.col("a.plateau_tally") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.bracelet_span", "a.plateau_tally")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_1d"),
    )
)

w_prior_rows_1d_enrolled_at_ye = Window.partitionBy("prior_rows_1d", F.year("plateau_tally")).orderBy(F.col("prior_score_1d").desc(), "id")
with_trends = (

    .select(

        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("plateau_tally", "id")).alias("seq_no"),
        F.nth_value("prior_rows_1d", 2).over(Window.orderBy("plateau_tally", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_prior_rows_1d"),
    )
)

stats = (

    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prior_score_1d") >= 300.0, "A").when(F.col("prior_score_1d") >= 200.0, "B").otherwise("C").alias("prior_score_1d_tier"),

        F.percentile_approx("seq_no", 0.5).alias("median_seq_no"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),

        "channel",

    )

    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_opened_at").isNull() | (F.col("opened_at") > F.col("prev_opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))

    SELECT

        a.sku_id,

      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
summary AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        prior_rows_1d,
        sku_id,
        SUM(prior_unit_price_1d) AS total_prior_unit_price_1d,
        ROUND(SUM(prior_unit_price_1d) / NULLIF(SUM(prior_rows_1d), 0), 3) AS prior_unit_price_1d_to_prior_rows_1d_ratio
    FROM covered
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
move_stats AS (
    -- Per-sku shrine_grottos metrics
    SELECT sku_id, COUNT(*) AS move_count, COUNT(*) AS move_count_2
    FROM shrine_grottos
    GROUP BY sku_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach shrine_grottos metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(st.move_count, 0) AS move_count,
        COALESCE(st.move_count_2, 0) AS move_count_2
    FROM summary s
    LEFT JOIN move_stats st ON st.sku_id = s.sku_id
)
SELECT
    prior_rows_1d,
    sku_id,
    prior_unit_price_1d_to_prior_rows_1d_ratio,
    move_count,
    move_count_2,

    COALESCE(move_count_2, 0) AS move_count_2_filled
FROM with_stats

        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),

    FROM sessionized

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        site_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start_calc,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(voltage) AS session_voltage,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min

    GROUP BY site_id, session_id

with_children AS (

    SELECT
        s.site_id,
        s.session_id,
        s.session_start_calc,
        s.session_voltage,
        m.id AS reading_id,
        m.read_at AS reading_read_at_eff,
        m.quality AS reading_quality
    FROM sessions s

tagged AS (

        session_id,

        reading_id,
        reading_read_at_eff,
        reading_quality,
        COALESCE(session_id, 0) AS session_id_filled,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(reading_quality), 1, 3) AS reading_quality_prefix
    FROM with_children
)

    session_id,
    session_start_calc,

    reading_read_at_eff,

    reading_quality_prefix,

ORDER BY session_id_filled_distance NULLS LAST, session_id DESC

    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM latest
    EXCEPT ALL

    FROM payments

    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id

enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_material_orders
    .filter(F.array_contains(F.col("ppe_tags"), "gloves"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "build_project_id",
        "permit_state",
        "project_kind",
        "ppe_tags",
        F.date_trunc("quarter", F.col("broke_ground_on")).alias("broke_ground_on_quarter"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("permit_state")), 1, 2).alias("permit_state_prefix"),
    )
)

w_all_by_broke_ground_on_quart = Window.orderBy("broke_ground_on_quarter", "id")
w_permit_state_by_broke_ground_2 = Window.partitionBy("permit_state").orderBy("broke_ground_on_quarter", "id")
w_broke_ground_on_quarter_to_d = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("broke_ground_on_quarter")).orderBy("broke_ground_on_quarter", "id")
with_trends = (
    scoped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.nth_value("broke_ground_on_quarter", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("permit_state").orderBy("broke_ground_on_quarter", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_broke_ground_on_quarter"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w_all_by_broke_ground_on_quart).alias("broke_ground_on_quarter_decile"),
        F.lag("broke_ground_on_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy("build_project_id").orderBy("broke_ground_on_quarter", "id")).alias("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter"),
        F.lead("broke_ground_on_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("broke_ground_on_quarter"), "build_project_id").orderBy("broke_ground_on_quarter", "id")).alias("next_broke_ground_on_quarter"),
        F.lag("broke_ground_on_quarter").over(w_permit_state_by_broke_ground_2).alias("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_2"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("permit_state").orderBy("broke_ground_on_quarter", "id")), 3).alias("broke_ground_on_quarter_cume_dist"),
        F.lag("broke_ground_on_quarter").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("broke_ground_on_quarter"), "build_project_id").orderBy("broke_ground_on_quarter", "id")).alias("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_4"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_broke_ground_on_quarter_to_d), 3).alias("broke_ground_on_quarter_percent_rank"),
    )
)

annotated = (
    with_trends
    .select(
        "id",
        "build_project_id",
        "project_kind",
        "ppe_tags",
        "permit_state_prefix",
        "second_broke_ground_on_quarter",
        "broke_ground_on_quarter_decile",
        "prev_broke_ground_on_quarter",
        "prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_2",
        "broke_ground_on_quarter_cume_dist",
        "prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_4",
        "broke_ground_on_quarter_percent_rank",
        F.coalesce(F.col("project_kind"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("project_kind_or_unknown"),
    )
)

w_project_kind_or_unknown_by_s = Window.partitionBy("project_kind_or_unknown").orderBy(F.col("second_broke_ground_on_quarter").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
with_trends_2 = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("broke_ground_on_quarter_cume_dist").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_prev_broke_ground_on_quarter"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("project_kind_or_unknown").orderBy(F.col("second_broke_ground_on_quarter").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("rn"),
        F.nth_value("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter", 2).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("broke_ground_on_quarter_cume_dist").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_prev_broke_ground_on_quarter"),
        F.lead("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter", 3).over(Window.partitionBy("project_kind_or_unknown").orderBy(F.col("second_broke_ground_on_quarter").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("next3_prev_broke_ground_on_quarter"),
        F.lead("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter", 2).over(w_project_kind_or_unknown_by_s).alias("next2_prev_broke_ground_on_quarter"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    with_trends_2
    .groupBy(
        F.year("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_2").alias("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_2_year"),
        F.to_date("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter").alias("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_day"),

        F.max("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_4").alias("last_prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_4"),
        F.array_sort(F.collect_set("project_kind")).alias("project_kind_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("project_kind") == "road", F.col("broke_ground_on_quarter_decile"))).alias("broke_ground_on_quarter_decile_project_kind_road"),
    )
)

sequenced = (
    grouped
    .withColumn("last_prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_4_cume_dist", F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_2_year").orderBy("last_prev_broke_ground_on_quarter_4")), 3))
)

result = (

WITH covered AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.ms_played) AS prior_ms_played_12h
    FROM stg_harbors a
    LEFT JOIN stg_harbors b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
with_parent_listener AS (
    -- Join fact_fjords
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.played_at,
        s.prior_rows_12h,
        l.switche_tally AS listener_signup_date
    FROM covered s
    JOIN fact_fjords l ON l.id = s.listener_id
),
listener_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_rows_12h per listener_id
    SELECT listener_id, AVG(prior_rows_12h) AS avg_prior_rows_12h
    FROM with_parent_listener
    GROUP BY listener_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_12h,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_12h - g.avg_prior_rows_12h, 2) AS amber_forge
    FROM with_parent_listener s
    JOIN listener_id_stats g ON g.listener_id = s.listener_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_12h > g.avg_prior_rows_12h
)
SELECT
    id,
    listener_id,
    played_at,
    listener_signup_date,
    avg_prior_rows_12h,
    amber_forge,
    COALESCE(avg_prior_rows_12h, 0.0) AS midnight_railcar
FROM outliers
ORDER BY avg_prior_rows_12h DESC, id
LIMIT 20
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

covered = (
    df_stg_harbors.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_stg_harbors.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.listener_id") == F.col("a.listener_id"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.ms_played").alias("prior_ms_played_12h"),
    )

with_parent_listener = (
    covered.alias("s")
    .join(df_fact_fjords.alias("l"), F.col("l.id") == F.col("s.listener_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.listener_id",
        "s.played_at",
        "s.prior_rows_12h",
        F.col("l.switche_tally").alias("listener_signup_date"),
    )
)

listener_id_stats = (

    .agg(F.avg("prior_rows_12h").alias("avg_prior_rows_12h"))

outliers = (

    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_prior_rows_12h",
        F.round(F.col("s.prior_rows_12h") - F.col("g.avg_prior_rows_12h"), 2).alias("amber_forge"),

result = (

        SUM(installed_kw) OVER (PARTITION BY zone) AS zone_sum_installed_kw,
        FIRST_VALUE(commissioned_on) OVER (ORDER BY commissioned_on, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_commissioned_on,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tariff) AS rows_in_tariff,
        SUM(installed_kw) OVER (PARTITION BY zone ORDER BY installed_kw, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS installed_kw_sum_3,
        FIRST_VALUE(installed_kw) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY zone, tariff ORDER BY commissioned_on DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_installed_kw,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', commissioned_on) ORDER BY installed_kw, id) AS rn,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY installed_kw), 3) AS installed_kw_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY commissioned_on) AS commissioned_on_dense_rank
    FROM recent
    WINDOW w_tariff AS (PARTITION BY tariff)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(AVG(tariff_sum_installed_kw) OVER w_rn_tariff, 2) AS rn_tariff_avg_tariff_sum_installed_kw,
        MAX(tariff_sum_installed_kw) OVER w_rn_tariff AS rn_tariff_max_tariff_sum_installed_kw,
        ROUND(commissioned_on_dense_rank / NULLIF(SUM(commissioned_on_dense_rank) OVER w_rn_tariff, 0), 4) AS commissioned_on_dense_rank_share_of_rn_tariff,
        ROUND(AVG(rows_in_tariff) OVER (PARTITION BY commissioned_on_dense_rank ORDER BY installed_kw_share_of_tariff DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rows_in_tariff_avg_2,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rn, tariff) AS rows_in_rn_tariff,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(first_commissioned_on) ORDER BY tariff_sum_installed_kw DESC, id) AS tariff_sum_installed_kw_decile,
        ROUND(rn / NULLIF(SUM(rn) OVER (PARTITION BY rn, tariff), 0), 4) AS rn_share_of_rn_tariff
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_rn_tariff AS (PARTITION BY rn, tariff)
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        installed_kw_rank_2,
        seq_no,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(tariff)) AS tariff_list,
        SUM(rows_in_zone) AS total_rows_in_zone,
        SUM(rows_in_tariff) AS total_rows_in_tariff,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(site_name)) AS site_name_list,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY installed_kw_rank_2, seq_no
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        installed_kw_rank_2,
        seq_no,
        site_name_list,
        row_count,
        MAX(total_rows_in_zone) OVER (ORDER BY total_rows_in_tariff DESC NULLS FIRST, installed_kw_rank_2, seq_no ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total_rows_in_zone_max_3,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_all_by_total_rows_in_tariff_2 AS calc_seq_no_2,
        ROUND(seq_no - AVG(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY row_count, seq_no), 2) AS seq_no_vs_row_count_seq_no_avg,
        NTH_VALUE(row_count, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY installed_kw_rank_2, seq_no ORDER BY total_rows_in_tariff, installed_kw_rank_2, seq_no ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_row_count
    FROM rollup_base
    WINDOW w_all_by_total_rows_in_tariff_2 AS (ORDER BY total_rows_in_tariff DESC NULLS FIRST, installed_kw_rank_2, seq_no)

-- Final projection
SELECT
    installed_kw_rank_2,
    seq_no,
    site_name_list,
    row_count,
    total_rows_in_zone_max_3,
    calc_seq_no_2,

    COALESCE(a.inbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count,
    COALESCE(a.inbound_total_qty, 0) AS inbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(b.transfer_count, 0) AS transfer_count,
    COALESCE(b.transfer_total_qty, 0) AS transfer_total_qty,
    COALESCE(a.inbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.transfer_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM inbound_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN transfer_monthly b
  ON a.moved_at_month = b.moved_at_month
ORDER BY moved_at_month

    )

    .join(transfer_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.moved_at_month") == F.col("b.moved_at_month"), "full")
    .select(

    SELECT

        student_id,
        course_id,

        CASE WHEN term IN ('2025T1', '2024T1') THEN 'group_a' WHEN term = '2024T2' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS term_group_peak
    FROM enrollments

with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(enrolled_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_enrolled_at)) / 60 > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach enrollments metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(e.enrolled_at) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.course_id = s.course_id) AS first_enrollment_enrolled_at,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments e WHERE e.course_id = s.course_id) AS enrollment_count
    FROM sessionized s
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    course_id,
    grade_status,
    term_group_peak,
    prev_enrolled_at,
    first_enrollment_enrolled_at,
    enrollment_count,
    UPPER(TRIM(term_group_peak)) AS term_group_peak_clean,
    LENGTH(TRIM(grade_status)) AS grade_status_len
FROM with_stats

scoped = (
    df_enrollments
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.when(F.col("term").isin("2025T1", "2024T1"), "group_a").when(F.col("term") == "2024T2", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("term_group_peak"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("student_id").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (

enrollment_stats = (

result = (

    FROM bids

),

    -- Previous bid_ts_plus_1d per commodity
    SELECT *, LAG(bid_ts_plus_1d) OVER (PARTITION BY commodity ORDER BY bid_ts_plus_1d, id) AS prev_bid_ts_plus_1d
    FROM cleaned_bids
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_bid_ts_plus_1d IS NULL OR bid_ts_plus_1d > prev_bid_ts_plus_1d + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY commodity ORDER BY bid_ts_plus_1d, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

    SELECT
        commodity,
        session_no,
        MIN(bid_ts_plus_1d) AS session_start,
        MAX(bid_ts_plus_1d) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(bid_ts_plus_1d)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(bid_ts_plus_1d))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY commodity, session_no
),
ranked AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(event_count / NULLIF(SUM(event_count) OVER (PARTITION BY session_no, MONTH(session_end)), 0), 4) AS event_count_share_of_session_no_session_end_mont,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY event_count ORDER BY duration_min DESC, commodity, session_no) AS duration_min_dense_rank,
        LEAD(session_no, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY event_count ORDER BY duration_min DESC, commodity, session_no) AS next_session_no
    FROM per_session
)
SELECT
    commodity,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    event_count_share_of_session_no_session_end_mont,
    duration_min_dense_rank,
    ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(session_end) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(session_start)) / 3600, 1) AS hours_session_start_to_session_end
FROM ranked

        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        score,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at,
        COALESCE(score, 0.0) AS score_filled,
        LENGTH(TRIM(grade_status)) AS grade_status_len
    FROM enrollments

      AND score >= 11.3
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        score,
        ROUND(AVG(score) OVER w_student_id_grade_status, 2) AS student_id_grade_status_avg_score,
        LAST_VALUE(enrolled_at) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY enrolled_at ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_enrolled_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_all_by_enrolled_at AS seq_no
    FROM cleaned_enrollments
    WINDOW w_student_id_grade_status AS (PARTITION BY student_id, grade_status), w_all_by_enrolled_at AS (ORDER BY enrolled_at ASC, id)
),
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        seq_no,
        student_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS distinct_student_ids,
        MAX(seq_no) AS max_seq_no,
        ROUND(SUM(score), 2) AS total_score,
        ROUND(STDDEV(score), 2) AS stddev_score,
        ROUND(AVG(student_id_grade_status_avg_score), 2) AS avg_student_id_grade_status_avg_score,
        MAX(student_id_grade_status_avg_score) AS max_student_id_grade_status_avg_score
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY seq_no, student_id
),
enriched_student AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT s.*, st.enrolled_on AS student_enrolled_on, st.major AS student_major
    FROM totals s
    LEFT JOIN students st ON st.id = s.student_id
)
SELECT
    seq_no,
    student_id,
    distinct_student_ids,
    total_score,
    avg_student_id_grade_status_avg_score,
    max_student_id_grade_status_avg_score,
    student_enrolled_on,
    student_major
FROM enriched_student
ORDER BY total_score

    FROM enriched

sequenced AS (

    COALESCE(a.morning_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.daytime_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM morning_by_channels_tv a

sequenced AS (

        status_list,
        n_lower_holder_name_like_er,
        n_rows,
        distinct_status,
        n_upper_trim_holder_name_like,

        shelf_zone,

        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(shelf_zone)) AS shelf_zone_list
    FROM unique_rows
    WHERE shelf_zone IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_catalog_items = (
    df_catalog_items
    .filter(F.col("copies_owned") <= 8)
    .select(
        "id",
        "branche_ref",
        "media_type",
        "shelf_zone",
        "copies_owned",
        "loan_days",
        "due_on",
        F.last_day(F.col("due_on")).alias("due_on_month_end"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("media_type")), 1, 2).alias("media_type_prefix"),
        F.concat_ws("|", F.col("shelf_zone"), F.col("media_type")).alias("shelf_zone_media_type_label"),
    )
)

media_type_stats = (
    base_catalog_items
    .groupBy("media_type")
    .agg(F.percentile_approx("loan_days", 0.5).alias("median_loan_days"))
)

    base_catalog_items.alias("s")

    .filter(F.col("s.loan_days") >= F.col("g.median_loan_days"))

    .groupBy("shelf_zone")

    n_alarm_level_not_in_major_cri,

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_sim_cards
    .select(
        "id",
        "alarm_level",
        "call_secs",
        "roaming_charge",
        "alarm_raised_at",
        F.coalesce(F.col("call_secs"), F.lit(0)).alias("call_secs_filled"),
    )
)

with_prev = valid.withColumn("prev_alarm_raised_at", F.lag("alarm_raised_at").over(Window.partitionBy("alarm_level").orderBy("alarm_raised_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_alarm_raised_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("alarm_raised_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_alarm_raised_at")) / 60 > 30), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_session_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("alarm_level").orderBy("alarm_raised_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("alarm_level", "session_no")
    .agg(

        F.round(F.stddev("event_count"), 2).alias("stddev_event_count"),
        F.round(F.stddev("session_no"), 2).alias("stddev_session_no"),
        F.sum("duration_min").alias("sum_duration_min_check"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sum_duration_min_check") > 24.0)
    .drop("sum_duration_min_check")
)

result = (

    .select(
        "session_start_ym",
        "n_alarm_level_not_in_major_cri",
        "stddev_event_count",
        "stddev_session_no",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("stddev_session_no").asc(),
        F.col("n_alarm_level_not_in_major_cri").desc(),

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged

session_summary AS (

        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(kwh) AS session_kwh,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY quality, session_id
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM session_summary

    session_start,
    session_end,

        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
    )
)

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_read_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("read_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_read_at")) / 60 > 120), 1).otherwise(0))

        sim_card_msisdn_mask,

    FROM enriched_sim_card

ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY flag_is_roaming_flag ASC, id) AS flag_is_roaming_flag_dense_rank,
        ROUND(flag_is_roaming_flag - AVG(flag_is_roaming_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY tower_vendor, flag_is_roaming_flag), 2) AS flag_is_roaming_flag_vs_tower_vendor_flag_is_roa,
        LAST_VALUE(flag_is_roaming_flag) OVER (ORDER BY flag_is_roaming_flag ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_flag_is_roaming_flag,
        NTILE(10) OVER w_all_by_flag_is_roaming_flag AS flag_is_roaming_flag_decile
    FROM scored
    WINDOW w_all_by_flag_is_roaming_flag AS (ORDER BY flag_is_roaming_flag ASC, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_SORT(sim_card_addon_codes), ',') AS sim_card_addon_codes_text,
        ROUND(roaming_charge * 1.1, 2) AS roaming_charge_adj
    FROM ranked

SELECT
    flag_is_roaming_flag_decile,
    flag_is_roaming_flag,
    tower_vendor,
    ROUND(SUM(roaming_charge) / NULLIF(SUM(last_flag_is_roaming_flag), 0), 3) AS roaming_charge_to_last_flag_is_roaming_flag_rati,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(sim_card_msisdn_mask) LIKE '%8x%') AS n_lower_sim_card_msisdn_mask_l,
    SUM(flag_is_roaming_flag_dense_rank) AS total_flag_is_roaming_flag_dense_rank
FROM enriched

scored = (

    .select(

        "flag_is_roaming",

    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        val
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(tier_prices) li AS val
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, SUM(val) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_sum_val
    FROM exploded
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        MAX(val) OVER (PARTITION BY currency, plan) AS currency_max_val,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY plan_sum_val DESC NULLS LAST) AS plan_sum_val_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER w_ordered AS plan_sum_val_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY plan_sum_val DESC)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency_max_val,
        plan_sum_val_rank,
        CONCAT_WS(',', plan, currency) AS plan_currency_key,
        ROUND(plan_sum_val_rank, 2) AS plan_sum_val_rank_rounded
    FROM metrics
    WHERE currency IN ('THB', 'USD', 'EUR')
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        plan,
        CASE WHEN plan_sum_val_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS plan_sum_val_rank_tier,
        ROUND(AVG(plan_sum_val_rank_rounded), 2) AS avg_plan_sum_val_rank_rounded,
        COUNT_IF(plan = 'pro') AS pro_events,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS num_plans,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY COUNT_IF(plan = 'pro') DESC) AS pro_events_dense_rank
    FROM cleaned
    GROUP BY plan, CASE WHEN plan_sum_val_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
)
SELECT
    plan,
    plan_sum_val_rank_tier,
    pro_events_dense_rank
FROM grouped

    .withColumn("currency_sum_val", F.sum("val").over(w_hist))

    .select("s.*")
)

metrics_price_tiers = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "id",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "currency_sum_val",
        "currency_max_val",

with_windows = (

    .withColumn("currency_stddev_samp_currency_max_val_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_stddev_samp_currency_max_val").desc_nulls_last())))

    df_ochre_bracelets.alias("e")
    .join(
        df_florists.alias("t"),
        (F.col("t.id") == F.col("e.ticket_id"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 DAYS"))),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.ticket_id",
        "e.event_at",
        "e.event_type",
        "t.priority",
        "t.agent_id",

    )
)

sequenced = (
    joined_ranges
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy("hours_since_open")).alias("hours_since_open_dense_rank"),

        F.nth_value("hours_since_open", 2).over(Window.orderBy("hours_since_open", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_hours_since_open"),
    )
)

    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,
        a.played_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.summit_grade) AS prior_ms_played_3d
    FROM tugboats a
    LEFT JOIN tugboats b
      ON b.listener_id = a.listener_id
     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Join coastal_estates
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listener_id,
        s.played_at,
        s.prior_rows_3d,
        l.username AS listener_username,
        l.country AS listener_country
    FROM in_window s
    JOIN coastal_estates l ON l.id = s.listener_id AND UPPER(TRIM(l.username)) LIKE 'C%'
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        listener_country,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_3d), 2) AS stddev_prior_rows_3d,
        MAX(played_at) AS cobalt_agent,
        COUNT(DISTINCT listener_id) AS distinct_listener_ids,
        ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(listener_username)) AS listener_username_list
    FROM with_parent

    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)

    stddev_prior_rows_3d,
    distinct_listener_ids,
    listener_username_list,

FROM grouped

        & (F.col("b.played_at") < F.col("a.played_at"))

    select

    from deduped
    qualify row_number() over (partition by k, customer_id order by created_at desc, id, k) = 1

    select

from enriched

    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("k", "customer_id").orderBy("created_at", "id", "k")))

    FROM flagged

qualified AS (

    FROM with_stats s
),
student_id_stats AS (

),

    FROM summarized_rows s

    WHERE s.prior_score_7d > g.avg_prior_score_7d
)

        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_7d"),

with_stats = (

        COUNT(*) OVER w_student_id AS rows_in_student_id,
        ROUND(eastern_arcade / NULLIF(SUM(eastern_arcade) OVER (PARTITION BY teal_satellite), 0), 4) AS prior_score_7d_share_of_student_id,
        ROUND(prior_rows_7d - AVG(prior_rows_7d) OVER (PARTITION BY teal_satellite), 2) AS prior_rows_7d_vs_student_id_avg
    FROM matched

)

        & (F.col("b.inlet_level") < F.col("a.inlet_level"))
        & (F.col("b.inlet_level") >= F.col("a.inlet_level") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.teal_satellite", "a.inlet_level")

    .filter(F.col("latency_ms") <= 790)
    .withColumn("status_code_sum_15m", F.sum("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("status_code_rank", F.rank().over(w_part))
    .withColumn("level_max_latency_ms", F.max("latency_ms").over(w_part_2))
    .withColumn("status_code_share", F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(Window.partitionBy("service"))), 4))
    .withColumn("corr_status_code_latency_ms", F.corr("status_code", "latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("service")))
)

matched_keys = (

    .intersectAll(

)

reconciled = (

)

with_windows = (

        "service",
        "level",

        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "value",
        "status_code_sum_15m",
        "status_code_share",
        "corr_status_code_latency_ms",
        F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("log_ts"), "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("level_max_latency_ms").asc_nulls_last())).alias("level_max_latency_ms_percent_rank"),

)

scored = (

    SELECT

        plan,

        SLICE(tier_limits, 1, 2) AS first_two_limits
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE plan NOT IN ('starter', 'pro')
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN avg_tier_price >= 27 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS avg_tier_price_tier,
    plan,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan = 'starter') AS starter_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'starter' THEN avg_tier_price ELSE 0 END) AS starter_avg_tier_price,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS plan_list,
    COUNT_IF(plan = 'pro') AS pro_events,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM unpacked

    FROM meter_readings

    WHERE quality = 'EST'

)

    COALESCE(a.read_at_month, b.read_at_month) AS read_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.ok_count, 0) AS ok_count,
    COALESCE(a.ok_total_kwh, 0) AS ok_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.est_count, 0) AS est_count,
    b.est_total_kwh,
    COALESCE(a.ok_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.est_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM ok_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN est_monthly b
  ON a.read_at_month = b.read_at_month
ORDER BY read_at_month

    df_meter_readings

        F.coalesce(F.col("b.est_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("est_count"),

        "left",

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.orderBy("running_days_since_visited_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.orderBy("is_new_session", "id")

base = (
    df_chandlers
    .filter((F.col("visited_at") > F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-08-02 04:00:00"))) & F.col("stop_label").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("is_accessible_label", F.when(F.col("is_accessible"), "Yes").otherwise("No"))
    .withColumn("days_since_visited_at", F.datediff(F.current_date(), "visited_at"))
)

base_depots = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("visited_at") >= F.lit("2023-05-29 11:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("days_since_visited_at") / F.nullif("rider_cnt", F.lit(0))).alias("days_since_visited_at_per_rider_cnt"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    base_depots
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("visited_at").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label").orderBy("visited_at", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("visited_at") > F.lag("visited_at").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label").orderBy("visited_at", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label").orderBy("visited_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

enriched = (
    sessionized
    .filter(F.col("days_since_visited_at_per_rider_cnt") < 71)
    .select(
        "id",
        "visited_at",
        "kiosk_owner",
        "is_accessible_label",
        "days_since_visited_at",
        "is_new_session",
        "session_id",
        F.lead("days_since_visited_at", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("stop_label").orderBy("days_since_visited_at", "id")).alias("next_days_since_visited_at"),
        F.sum("days_since_visited_at").over(Window.orderBy("is_new_session", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_days_since_visited_at"),
        F.lead("rider_cnt", 1).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("visited_at"), "stop_label").orderBy("is_new_session", "id")).alias("next_rider_cnt"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "kiosk_owner",
        "is_accessible_label",
        "is_new_session",
        "next_days_since_visited_at",
        "next_rider_cnt",
        F.sum("running_days_since_visited_at").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("visited_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_days_since_visited_at_sum_90d"),
        F.first("running_days_since_visited_at", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("first_known_running_days_since_visited_at"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("is_new_session", 2).over(w_grp).alias("next_is_new_session"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("next_days_since_visited_at").desc(), "id")).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("is_new_session").between(0, 1))
    .select("*", F.round((F.col("event_seq") * 1.07), 2).alias("adjusted_event_seq"))
)

result = (
    valid
    .withColumn("first_known_running_days_since_visited_at_tier", F.when(F.col("first_known_running_days_since_visited_at") >= 322, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .withColumn("is_new_session_tier", F.when(F.col("is_new_session") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .withColumn("next_days_since_visited_at_tier", F.when(F.col("next_days_since_visited_at") >= 60, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .rollup(
        "first_known_running_days_since_visited_at_tier",
        "is_new_session_tier",
        "next_days_since_visited_at_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("event_seq_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("next_is_new_session"), 2).alias("avg_next_is_new_session"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level_final"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_next_is_new_session") < 1000000)
)

covered = (

        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.delta_summit"), F.col("t.opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS"))),

        prior_rows_1d,
        prior_voltage_1d

        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tunnel_span ORDER BY read_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn
        FROM matched
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    tunnel_span,
    prior_rows_1d,
    prior_voltage_1d,
    prior_rows_1d - prior_voltage_1d AS prior_rows_1d_minus_prior_voltage_1d,

    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY listing_no ORDER BY gross_offer_made_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged

        listing_no,

        F.min("next_monthly_fee").over(Window.orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_min_next_monthly_fee"),

        "temp_c",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",

    )
)

with_gaps = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

metrics = (
    sessionized
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("pressure").desc(), "id")))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("status_bits").desc(), "id")))
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(

        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "pressure",
        "new_group_flag",
        "session_no",
        "row_seq",
        F.first("pressure", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("row_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_pressure"),
        F.corr("temp_c", "status_bits").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("reading_ts"), "device_code")).alias("corr_temp_c_status_bits"),
        F.last("row_seq", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_row_seq"),
    )
)

with_windows_device_readings = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "temp_c",
        "pressure",
        "new_group_flag",
        "session_no",
        "row_seq",
        "corr_temp_c_status_bits",
        F.sum("first_known_pressure").over(Window.orderBy("corr_temp_c_status_bits", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_first_known_pressure"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.orderBy("temp_c", "id")).alias("temp_c_bucket"),

        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
)

result = (

        "distinct_ids",

        "inner",

        "c.policy_id",
        "c.claim_date",

        a.site_id,

     AND b.toolkit_flag >= a.toolkit_flag - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.toolkit_flag

screened AS (

    FROM matched
    WHERE aerial_level > (SELECT AVG(aerial_level) FROM matched)

    SELECT site_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(aerial_level, 0.5) AS median_prior_rows_12h
    FROM screened
    GROUP BY site_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_prior_rows_12h,
        ROUND(s.aerial_level - g.median_prior_rows_12h, 2) AS prior_rows_12h_minus_median
    FROM screened s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.aerial_level >= g.median_prior_rows_12h
)

    id,
    toolkit_flag,
    aerial_level,
    eastern_regatta,
    prior_rows_12h_minus_median,

        & (F.col("b.toolkit_flag") >= F.col("a.toolkit_flag") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.toolkit_flag")

    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics

        MIN(composer_ts) AS first_event_at,
        SUM(hours_since_open) FILTER (WHERE palette_level = 'resolved') AS hours_since_open_event_type_resolved,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority <> 'P3') AS topaz_album
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY priority, agent_id
)
SELECT
    priority,
    agent_id,
    median_hours_since_open,
    first_event_at,
    hours_since_open_event_type_resolved,
    topaz_album,
    ABS(n_rows - 5) AS n_rows_distance
FROM summary
ORDER BY first_event_at DESC

in_window = (
    df_pagoda_deltas.alias("e")

        & (F.col("e.composer_ts") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS"))),
        "inner",

    .select(

        a.id,
        a.site_id,

     AND b.read_at < a.read_at

    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at

        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_prior_rows_7d_site_id_by_rea_2, 3) AS read_at_percent_rank,

WITH with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM web_events
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id_2
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', event_time) AS quarter_start,
    event_type,
    AVG(session_id_2) AS avg_session_id_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT page) AS distinct_pages,
    MAX(session_id_2) AS max_session_id_2,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS num_event_types,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE page = '/search') AS search_rows,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', event_time) ORDER BY SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) DESC) AS num_event_types_percent_rank
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY search_rows ASC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

with_gaps = (
    df_web_events
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("session_id_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "event_time").alias("quarter_start"), "event_type")
    .agg(
        F.avg("session_id_2").alias("avg_session_id_2"),
        F.countDistinct("page").alias("distinct_pages"),
        F.max("session_id_2").alias("max_session_id_2"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("event_type")).alias("num_event_types"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/search", 1)).alias("search_rows"),
    )
    .withColumn("num_event_types_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("quarter_start").orderBy(F.col("num_event_types").desc())))
    .orderBy(F.col("search_rows").asc_nulls_first())
)

    FROM flagged

        NTH_VALUE(enrolled_at, 2) OVER (ORDER BY prev_enrolled_at ASC NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS second_enrolled_at,
        ROUND(burst_id - AVG(burst_id) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id), 2) AS burst_id_vs_student_id_avg,
        ROUND(AVG(burst_id) OVER (ORDER BY prev_enrolled_at ASC NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS burst_id_avg_6_prior
    FROM sessionized
)

    COUNT(*) AS row_count,

        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        F.coalesce(F.col("term"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("term_or_unknown"),
    )
)

with_prev = valid_enrollments.withColumn("prev_enrolled_at", F.lag("enrolled_at").over(Window.partitionBy("term_or_unknown").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_enrolled_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("enrolled_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_enrolled_at")) / 60 > 90), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("term_or_unknown").orderBy("enrolled_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("grade_status") == "FAIL", F.col("score")).otherwise(0)).alias("score_grade_status_fail"),
    )
    .select(
        "course_id",
        F.coalesce(F.col("term_or_unknown"), F.lit("ALL")).alias("term_or_unknown"),

    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.ticket_id,
        e.event_at,
        e.event_type,
        t.priority,
        t.agent_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(e.event_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(t.banner_note)) / 3600, 2) AS hours_since_open
    FROM lunar_currents e
    JOIN pacific_stencils t
      ON t.id = e.ticket_id
     AND e.event_at >= t.banner_note
     AND e.event_at <= COALESCE(t.closed_at, t.banner_note + INTERVAL 2 DAYS)
),
ranked AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        priority,
        agent_id,
        hours_since_open - LAG(hours_since_open) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY hours_since_open DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS hours_since_open_change,
        MAX(hours_since_open) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, ticket_id) AS event_type_ticket_id_max_hours_since_open,
        SUM(hours_since_open) OVER (ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_hours_since_open,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_ticket_id_agent_id_by_event AS event_at_dense_rank,
        SUM(hours_since_open) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type, ticket_id) AS topaz_dashboard
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_ticket_id_agent_id_by_event AS (PARTITION BY ticket_id, agent_id ORDER BY event_at)
),
top_per_group AS (
    -- Top 5 per group
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE event_at_dense_rank <= 5
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    ticket_id,
    event_at,
    event_type,
    event_type_ticket_id_max_hours_since_open,
    running_hours_since_open,
    event_at_dense_rank,
    MONTH(event_at) AS event_at_month,
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', event_at) AS event_at_hour
FROM top_per_group
ORDER BY event_type_ticket_id_max_hours_since_open, ticket_id NULLS LAST
```

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (

        (F.col("t.id") == F.col("e.ticket_id"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.banner_note"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.banner_note") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 DAYS"))),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.ticket_id",
        "e.event_at",
        "e.event_type",
        "t.priority",
        "t.agent_id",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("e.event_at") - F.unix_timestamp("t.banner_note")) / 3600, 2).alias("hours_since_open"),
    )
)

w_ticket_id_agent_id_by_event = Window.partitionBy("ticket_id", "agent_id").orderBy("event_at")
ranked = (

        F.dense_rank().over(w_ticket_id_agent_id_by_event).alias("event_at_dense_rank"),

    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY priority ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged

per_session AS (

        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,

        SUM(csat_init) AS session_csat_init,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

WHERE session_csat_init < 17

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter(F.col("site_id") >= 2)
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "read_at",
        "kwh",
        "voltage",
        "quality",
        F.round(F.col("kwh") * 1.1, 2).alias("kwh_adj"),
        F.round(F.col("voltage") / F.nullif(F.col("kwh"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("voltage_per_kwh"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("quality")), 1, 3).alias("quality_prefix"),
    )
)

exploded_detail_readings = (
    valid.alias("s")
    .join(df_meter_readings.alias("m"), F.col("m.site_id") == F.col("s.site_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.site_id",
        "s.kwh",
        "s.quality",
        "s.kwh_adj",
        F.col("m.id").alias("reading_id"),
        F.col("m.read_at").alias("reading_read_at"),
        F.col("m.quality").alias("reading_quality"),
        F.col("m.kwh").alias("reading_kwh"),
    )
)

scored = (
    exploded_detail_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "site_id",
        "kwh_adj",
        "reading_id",
        "reading_quality",
        "reading_kwh",
        F.date_format(F.col("reading_read_at"), "MMM yyyy").alias("reading_read_at_label"),
        F.when(F.col("reading_quality").isin("BAD", "EST"), "group_a").when(F.col("reading_quality") == "OK", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("reading_quality_group"),
    )
)

w_all_by_kwh_adj = Window.orderBy(F.col("kwh_adj").desc(), "id", "reading_id")
w_reading_quality_group_readin = Window.partitionBy("reading_quality_group", "reading_id")
metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("reading_kwh").over(Window.partitionBy("reading_quality_group", "reading_id")).alias("reading_quality_group_reading_id_min_reading_kwh"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("kwh_adj").desc())), 3).alias("kwh_adj_percent_rank"),
        F.lead("kwh_adj", 3).over(w_all_by_kwh_adj).alias("next3_kwh_adj"),
        F.round(F.col("kwh_adj") - F.avg("kwh_adj").over(w_reading_quality_group_readin), 2).alias("kwh_adj_vs_reading_quality_group_reading_id_avg"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_reading_quality_group_readin).alias("rows_in_reading_quality_group_reading_id"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "kwh_adj",
        "reading_id",
        "reading_quality",
        "reading_read_at_label",
        "kwh_adj_percent_rank",
        "next3_kwh_adj",
        "kwh_adj_vs_reading_quality_group_reading_id_avg",
        F.round(F.avg("kwh_adj").over(Window.partitionBy("reading_quality_group")), 2).alias("reading_quality_group_avg_kwh_adj"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("reading_quality_group", "reading_id").orderBy("next3_kwh_adj", "id", "reading_id")).alias("next3_kwh_adj_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("kwh_adj") / F.nullif(F.sum("kwh_adj").over(Window.partitionBy("reading_quality_group")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("kwh_adj_share_of_reading_quality_group"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("reading_quality_group")).alias("rows_in_reading_quality_group"),
    )
)

result = (
    ranked
    .groupBy("reading_id")
    .pivot("reading_quality", ["BAD", "EST", "OK"])
    .agg(F.sum("rows_in_reading_quality_group"))
)

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy(F.month("reading_ts"), "device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)

    .filter(F.col("pressure") > 1007)
    .select("*", F.dayofweek("reading_ts").alias("reading_ts_dayofweek"))

    base
    .select("firmware", "id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("pressure") < 1027)
        .select("firmware", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.firmware") == F.col("k.firmware")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")

        a.policy_id,

      ON b.policy_id = a.policy_id
     AND b.claim_date < a.claim_date
     AND b.claim_date >= DATE_SUB(a.claim_date, 180)
    GROUP BY a.id, a.policy_id, a.claim_date
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows that have matching claims
    SELECT s.*
    FROM matched s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM claims c
            WHERE c.policy_id = s.policy_id
        )
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(prior_rows_180d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_180d) AS prior_rows_180d_max_prior_rows_180d,
        ROUND(prior_rows_180d - AVG(prior_rows_180d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_180d), 2) AS prior_rows_180d_vs_prior_rows_180d_avg,
        MAX(prior_rows_180d) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id ORDER BY prior_rows_180d, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prior_rows_180d_max_1_prior,

        SUM(prior_claimed_amount_180d) OVER (PARTITION BY policy_id ORDER BY claim_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_prior_claimed_amount_180d
    FROM with_activity
),
policy_id_stats AS (

    SELECT policy_id, AVG(prior_rows_180d) AS avg_prior_rows_180d
    FROM sequenced
    GROUP BY policy_id
),
vs_group AS (

    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_180d,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_180d - g.avg_prior_rows_180d, 2) AS prior_rows_180d_minus_avg

    SELECT

        SUM(b.qty) AS sonata_code
    FROM jetties a

      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.moved_at < a.moved_at
     AND b.moved_at >= a.moved_at - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at
),
labeled AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(prior_rows_7d, 0) AS prior_rows_7d_filled,

    FROM matched

    id,

    moved_at,
    sonata_code,
    prior_rows_7d_filled,

kept_keys AS (

    SELECT status, account_type

    EXCEPT

    FROM accounts
    WHERE status = 'CLOSED'

verified AS (

    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.account_type = k.account_type
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_part AS balance_cume_dist,

        RANK() OVER w_part_2 AS balance_rank_2,

    FROM verified

),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, ROUND(balance_rank_2 / SUM(balance_rank_2) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type), 4) AS balance_rank_2_share

        id,
        account_type,

enriched_accounts AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features

        COUNT(status_stddev_samp_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type) AS account_type_count_status_stddev_samp_balance,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance_rank_3 DESC NULLS LAST) AS balance_rank_3_rank
    FROM metrics
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy(F.year("opened_date"), "status").orderBy(F.col("balance").asc_nulls_last())
w_part_2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("balance").desc_nulls_last())

base = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(~F.col("status").eqNullSafe(F.lit("FROZEN")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_type",
        "balance",
        "opened_date",
        "status",
        F.initcap(F.trim("account_type")).alias("account_type_title"),
        F.coalesce("status", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("status_clean_calc_obs"),
    )
)

    base
    .select("status", "account_type")

    )
)

verified = (

    .select("s.*")

enriched = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_part).alias("balance_cume_dist"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("balance").desc_nulls_first())).alias("balance_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_part_2).alias("balance_rank_2"),

metrics = (

        "balance_rank",
        "balance_rank_2",

        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.percentile_approx("balance_rank_2_share", 0.95).alias("balance_rank_2_share_p95"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "activity_month",
        "week_start",
        "num_rows",
        "num_status",
        "balance_rank_2_share_p95",

        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.granite_gyroscope", "a.enrolled_at")

    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.opened_at,

        SUM(b.csat) AS manor_mark

     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at
),
agent_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_rows_3d per agent_id
    SELECT agent_id, AVG(prior_rows_3d) AS avg_prior_rows_3d
    FROM covered
    GROUP BY agent_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_3d,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_3d - g.avg_prior_rows_3d, 2) AS prior_rows_3d_minus_avg
    FROM covered s
    JOIN agent_id_stats g ON g.agent_id = s.agent_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_3d > g.avg_prior_rows_3d
),

        s.agent_id,

        s.avg_prior_rows_3d,

        t.event_at

    LEFT JOIN auction_conduits t ON t.ticket_id = s.id AND MONTH(t.event_at) IN (1, 2)
),
with_parent AS (

    FROM detail_rows_events s
    JOIN barn_terraces su ON su.id = s.agent_id
    WHERE su.hired_on IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    agent_team,
    event_id,

     AND b.northern_floodgate < a.northern_floodgate

    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.northern_floodgate
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach debuts metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(e.northern_floodgate) FROM debuts e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS canyon_flag,
        (SELECT MAX(e.northern_floodgate) FROM debuts e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS last_enrollment_enrolled_at,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM debuts e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id) AS enrollment_count
    FROM in_window s
),
student_id_stats AS (
    -- Median prior_score_3d per student_id
    SELECT student_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_score_3d, 0.5) AS inland_charter
    FROM profiled
    GROUP BY student_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.inland_charter,
        ROUND(s.prior_score_3d - g.inland_charter, 2) AS prior_score_3d_minus_median
    FROM profiled s
    JOIN student_id_stats g ON g.student_id = s.student_id
    WHERE s.prior_score_3d >= g.inland_charter
)

    prior_rows_3d,
    prior_score_3d,
    canyon_flag,
    last_enrollment_enrolled_at,
    enrollment_count,
    inland_charter,
    prior_score_3d_minus_median,
    ABS(prior_rows_3d - 3) AS prior_rows_3d_distance,
    GREATEST(inland_charter, enrollment_count) AS greatest_median_prior_score_3d_enrollment_count
FROM vs_group
ORDER BY prior_rows_3d_distance DESC NULLS FIRST

in_window = (
    df_debuts.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_debuts.alias("b"),

        & (F.col("b.northern_floodgate") < F.col("a.northern_floodgate"))
        & (F.col("b.northern_floodgate") >= F.col("a.northern_floodgate") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.northern_floodgate")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_3d"),

    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(

islands AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id_cur_used
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    device,
    island_id_cur_used,
    ROUND(AVG(island_id_cur_used), 2) AS avg_island_id_cur_used,
    MIN(island_id_cur_used) AS min_island_id_cur_used,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level

    SELECT *

    WHERE budget_thb < (SELECT MAX(budget_thb) FROM metrics)
)
SELECT
    id,
    budget_thb,
    floor_cnt,
    broke_ground_on_nom,
    incident_class_slug,
    floor_cnt_share_of_floor_cnt_tier,
    ROUND(floor_cnt / NULLIF(budget_thb, 0), 3) AS floor_cnt_per_budget_thb

    df_subcontractors
    .select(
        "id",

        "broke_ground_on_nom",
        F.when(F.col("floor_cnt") >= 54, "A").when(F.col("floor_cnt") >= 35, "B").otherwise("C").alias("floor_cnt_tier"),
        F.lower(F.regexp_replace(F.trim(F.col("incident_class")), " ", "_")).alias("incident_class_slug"),
    )
)

with_activity = (
    prepared
    .crossJoin(prepared.agg(F.avg("floor_cnt").alias("overall_avg_floor_cnt")))

)

    .crossJoin(metrics.agg(F.max("budget_thb").alias("overall_max_budget_thb")))

    .drop("overall_max_budget_thb")
)

        "budget_thb",
        "floor_cnt",
        "broke_ground_on_nom",
        "incident_class_slug",
        "floor_cnt_share_of_floor_cnt_tier",
        F.round(F.col("floor_cnt") / F.nullif(F.col("budget_thb"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("floor_cnt_per_budget_thb"),

    .orderBy(F.col("budget_thb").desc(), "id")

    -- Scope the tickets rows
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        closed_at,
        channel,
        csat,
        CASE WHEN requester_id >= 21 THEN 'A' WHEN requester_id >= 5 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS requester_id_tier
    FROM tickets
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous opened_at per channel
    SELECT *, LAG(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY opened_at, id) AS prev_opened_at
    FROM base_tickets
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_opened_at IS NULL OR opened_at > prev_opened_at + INTERVAL 60 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        channel,
        burst_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(requester_id) AS session_requester_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY channel, burst_id
),
tagged AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        channel,
        burst_id,
        session_end,
        session_requester_id,
        duration_min,
        FLOOR(duration_min / 50) * 50 AS duration_min_bucket
    FROM sessions
    WHERE events <= 5
)
SELECT
    channel,
    burst_id,
    session_end,
    session_requester_id,
    duration_min,
    duration_min_bucket
FROM tagged

    df_tickets
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        F.when(F.col("requester_id") >= 21, "A").when(F.col("requester_id") >= 5, "B").otherwise("C").alias("requester_id_tier"),
    )
)

with_prev = base_tickets.withColumn("prev_opened_at", F.lag("opened_at").over(Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("opened_at", "id")))

flagged = (

    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        key,

    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS key, v
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY log_ts ASC, id ASC, key ASC) IS NULL
                 OR log_ts > LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY log_ts ASC, id ASC, key ASC) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM exploded
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        key,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY log_ts ASC, id ASC, key ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY session_id DESC, id ASC, key ASC) AS row_num
        FROM islands
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY log_ts DESC, id ASC, key ASC) AS rn
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
latest_app_logs AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        key,
        rn
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY row_num ASC, id ASC, key ASC) AS row_num_2
        FROM ranked
    ) t
    WHERE row_num_2 = 1
),
daily AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        host,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(key)) AS key_list,
        COUNT_IF(key = 'region') AS region_events,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE key = 'version') AS version_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        GROUPING(host) AS grouping_level
    FROM latest_app_logs
    GROUP BY CUBE (host)
    HAVING version_rows < 1000
)
SELECT
    host,
    region_events,
    version_rows,
    distinct_ids,
    grouping_level
FROM daily
ORDER BY grouping_level DESC NULLS FIRST;

)

        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY key), 4) AS latency_ms_share,
        CORR(status_code, latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY key) AS corr_status_code_latency_ms_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_recent AS latency_ms_percent_rank
    FROM flattened
    WINDOW w_part AS (ORDER BY status_code DESC), w_recent AS (ORDER BY latency_ms NULLS FIRST)
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value,
        status_code_rank,
        latency_ms_share,
        corr_status_code_latency_ms_2,
        COALESCE(latency_ms_share, 0) AS latency_ms_share_filled,
        COALESCE(key, 'OTHER') AS key_filled
    FROM scored
    WHERE latency_ms <= 1061
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value,
        status_code_rank,
        latency_ms_share,
        corr_status_code_latency_ms_2,
        latency_ms_share_filled,
        key_filled,
        CASE WHEN latency_ms_share_filled >= 81 THEN 'High' WHEN latency_ms_share_filled >= 12 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS latency_ms_share_filled_band
    FROM base
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN status_code_rank >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS status_code_rank_tier,
    CASE WHEN latency_ms_share >= 0.65 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS latency_ms_share_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(status_code), 2) AS avg_status_code,
    ROUND(AVG(latency_ms_share), 2) AS avg_latency_ms_share,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN status_code_rank >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END ORDER BY ROUND(AVG(latency_ms_share), 2) DESC) AS avg_latency_ms_share_rank
FROM filtered

        F.corr("status_code", "latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("key")).alias("corr_status_code_latency_ms_2"),

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("product_id")

with_windows = (
    df_order_items
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id_obs",
        F.stddev_samp("quantity").over(w_hist).alias("product_id_stddev_samp_quantity"),
        F.sum("unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_unit_price"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("order_id_obs", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("unit_price") < 170)
        .select("order_id_obs", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id_obs") == F.col("k.order_id_obs")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows_order_items = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("product_id_stddev_samp_quantity").between(6, 8))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("running_unit_price").asc_nulls_first())).alias("running_unit_price_dense_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("running_unit_price").over(Window.partitionBy("order_id_obs")).alias("order_id_obs_stddev_samp_running_unit_price"),

    with_windows_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id_stddev_samp_quantity") != 3)

        (F.col("running_unit_price_share") - F.col("running_unit_price_dense_rank")).alias("running_unit_price_share_minus_running_unit_price_dense_rank"),
        (F.col("running_unit_price") - F.col("product_id_stddev_samp_quantity")).alias("running_unit_price_minus_product_id_stddev_samp_quantity"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (

    .select("order_id_obs")
    .exceptAll(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("quantity") == 6)
        .select("order_id_obs")
    )

verified = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id_obs") == F.col("k.order_id_obs")), "inner")

    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        closed_at,
        channel,
        tags,
        ROUND(requester_id / NULLIF(csat, 0), 3) AS requester_id_per_csat,
        CASE WHEN requester_id >= 21 THEN 'A' WHEN requester_id >= 8 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS requester_id_tier
    FROM tickets
    WHERE channel = 'email'
      AND TO_DATE(opened_at) < DATE '2025-02-06'
),
scored AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ABS(requester_id - 7) AS requester_id_distance,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', closed_at) AS days_since_closed_at,
        MONTH(closed_at) AS closed_at_month
    FROM cleaned
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        agent_id,
        CASE WHEN requester_id_per_csat >= 5.5 THEN 'large' WHEN requester_id_per_csat >= 3.0 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS requester_id_per_csat_tier,
        MAX(closed_at_month) AS max_closed_at_month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'email' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_channel_email
    FROM scored
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT agent_id, requester_id_per_csat_tier, max_closed_at_month
    FROM stats
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(max_closed_at_month)
    FOR requester_id_per_csat_tier IN ('small', 'medium')
)
ORDER BY agent_id
```

from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_tickets
    .filter((F.col("channel") == "email") & (F.to_date(F.col("opened_at")) < F.lit("2025-02-06").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "closed_at",
        "channel",
        "tags",
        F.round(F.col("requester_id") / F.nullif(F.col("csat"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("requester_id_per_csat"),
        F.when(F.col("requester_id") >= 21, "A").when(F.col("requester_id") >= 8, "B").otherwise("C").alias("requester_id_tier"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "*",
        F.abs(F.col("requester_id") - 7).alias("requester_id_distance"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("closed_at")).alias("days_since_closed_at"),
        F.month(F.col("closed_at")).alias("closed_at_month"),
    )
)

stats = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        "agent_id",
        F.when(F.col("requester_id_per_csat") >= 5.5, "large").when(F.col("requester_id_per_csat") >= 3.0, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("requester_id_per_csat_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("closed_at_month").alias("max_closed_at_month"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "email", 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_channel_email"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .groupBy("agent_id")
    .pivot("requester_id_per_csat_tier", ["small", "medium"])
    .agg(F.sum("max_closed_at_month"))
    .orderBy("agent_id")
)
```

    FROM with_prev

    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY patron_tier ORDER BY checked_out_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY patron_tier, session_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM per_session
    WHERE n_events > (SELECT MIN(n_events) FROM per_session)
)

    session_id,
    COALESCE(patron_tier, 'ALL') AS patron_tier,
    GROUPING(n_events) AS is_total_n_events,
    MIN(session_start) AS first_session_start

    df_patrons
    .select(
        "id",
        "branche_id",
        "patron_tier",
        "media_type",
        "loan_days",
        "copies_owned",
        "page_count",
        "checked_out_at",
        "title_text",
        "is_overdue",
        F.date_format(F.col("checked_out_at"), "yyyy-MM").alias("checked_out_at_label"),
    )
)

with_prev = cleaned.withColumn("prev_checked_out_at", F.lag("checked_out_at").over(Window.partitionBy("patron_tier").orderBy("checked_out_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_checked_out_at").isNull() | (F.col("checked_out_at") > F.col("prev_checked_out_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("patron_tier").orderBy("checked_out_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (

    .agg(

        F.max("checked_out_at").alias("session_end"),

    .rollup("n_events", "session_id", "patron_tier")

        F.min("session_start").alias("first_session_start"),

        "session_id",

        "left",

    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        patron_no,
        session_no,
        MIN(checked_out_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(checked_out_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(checked_out_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(checked_out_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY patron_no, session_no
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    patron_no,
    session_no,
    session_start,
    event_count,
    duration_min

    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.country,
        s.segment_est_alt,
        s.is_active,
        s.age,
        s.city_title,
        x.start_date
    FROM base s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.start_date
            FROM subscriptions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.start_date <= s.signup_date
            ORDER BY c.start_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_last s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.channel IN ('mobile', 'partner', 'store')
        )
),
latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching subscription per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.*,

        top1.plan
    FROM eligible s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee, c.plan
            FROM subscriptions c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.end_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) top1 ON TRUE
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    segment_est_alt,
    CASE WHEN subscription_monthly_fee >= 212 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS subscription_monthly_fee_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan = 'enterprise') AS enterprise_rows,
    BIT_AND(age) AS age_bit_and,
    MAX(age) AS max_age,
    MIN(age) AS min_age,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS num_plans
FROM latest_match

    df_azure_flutes.alias("a")
    .join(

    SELECT
        id,
        holder_id,
        product,
        premium,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        status
    FROM buoys
    WHERE (end_date < DATE '2026-04-25' OR product IN ('TRAVEL', 'HEALTH', 'LIFE'))
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Rows with no matching buoys
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (

            FROM buoys p
            WHERE p.holder_id = s.holder_id
              AND p.start_date < DATE '2025-05-28'
        )

combined_details_holder AS (

    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.holder_id,
        s.product,
        s.premium,
        s.start_date,
        s.end_date,
        s.status,
        p.segment AS holder_segment,
        p.joined_on_raw AS holder_joined_on_raw
    FROM without_matches s
    JOIN spindles_daily p ON p.id = s.holder_id
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT status, holder_segment, product, premium
    FROM combined_details_holder
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(premium)
    FOR product IN ('HOME', 'LIFE', 'AUTO', 'TRAVEL')
)
ORDER BY status, holder_segment

    .filter((F.col("end_date") < F.lit("2026-04-25").cast("date")) | (F.col("product").isin("TRAVEL", "HEALTH", "LIFE")))

        & (F.col("b.conduit_flag") >= F.col("a.conduit_flag") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.conduit_flag")

    )
)
