```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.student_id,
        a.satellite_note,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.score) AS prior_score_3d
    FROM tugboats_daily a
    LEFT JOIN tugboats_daily b
      ON b.student_id = a.student_id
     AND b.satellite_note < a.satellite_note
     AND b.satellite_note >= a.satellite_note - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.satellite_note
),
student_id_stats AS (
    -- Max prior_rows_3d per student_id
    SELECT student_id, MAX(prior_rows_3d) AS max_prior_rows_3d
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY student_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.max_prior_rows_3d,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_3d - g.max_prior_rows_3d, 2) AS caravan_tally
    FROM in_window s
    JOIN student_id_stats g ON g.student_id = s.student_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_3d = g.max_prior_rows_3d
),
enrollment_stats AS (
    -- Per-student tugboats_daily metrics
    SELECT student_id, MAX(satellite_note) AS last_enrollment_enrolled_at
    FROM tugboats_daily
    GROUP BY student_id
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach tugboats_daily metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        e.last_enrollment_enrolled_at
    FROM compared s
    LEFT JOIN enrollment_stats e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
),
without_matches AS (
    -- Compare against the overall min
    SELECT *
    FROM summarized_rows
    WHERE prior_rows_3d > (SELECT MIN(prior_rows_3d) FROM summarized_rows)
)
SELECT id, measure, reading
FROM (
    SELECT id, caravan_tally, max_prior_rows_3d, prior_score_3d
    FROM without_matches
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR measure IN (caravan_tally AS prior_rows_3d_minus_max_v, max_prior_rows_3d AS crystal_amt, prior_score_3d AS m_prior_score_3d)
) unp
ORDER BY id, measure
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

in_window = (
    df_tugboats_daily.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_tugboats_daily.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.satellite_note") < F.col("a.satellite_note"))
        & (F.col("b.satellite_note") >= F.col("a.satellite_note") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.satellite_note")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.score").alias("prior_score_3d"),
    )
)

student_id_stats = (
    in_window
    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(F.max("prior_rows_3d").alias("max_prior_rows_3d"))
)

compared = (
    in_window.alias("s")
    .join(student_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.student_id") == F.col("s.student_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.prior_rows_3d") == F.col("g.max_prior_rows_3d"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.max_prior_rows_3d",
        F.round(F.col("s.prior_rows_3d") - F.col("g.max_prior_rows_3d"), 2).alias("caravan_tally"),
    )
)

enrollment_stats = (
    df_tugboats_daily
    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(F.max("satellite_note").alias("last_enrollment_enrolled_at"))

summarized_rows = (
    compared.alias("s")

    .select("s.*", "e.last_enrollment_enrolled_at")
)

without_matches = (
    summarized_rows
    .crossJoin(summarized_rows.agg(F.min("prior_rows_3d").alias("overall_min_prior_rows_3d")))
    .filter(F.col("prior_rows_3d") > F.col("overall_min_prior_rows_3d"))
    .drop("overall_min_prior_rows_3d")
)

result = (

    .select(

        F.col("max_prior_rows_3d").alias("crystal_amt"),
        F.col("prior_score_3d").alias("m_prior_score_3d"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["prior_rows_3d_minus_max_v", "crystal_amt", "m_prior_score_3d"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="reading",
```

```sql
        ROUND(score_rank_2 - AVG(score_rank_2) OVER (PARTITION BY score_rank_2, score_quartile), 2) AS score_rank_2_vs_score_rank_2_score_quartile_avg,
        ROUND(score_cume_dist - AVG(score_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY score_rank_2, score_quartile), 2) AS score_cume_dist_vs_score_rank_2_score_quartile_a
    FROM ranked
),
top_per_group AS (
    -- First row per group
    SELECT
        id,
        term_ref,
        score_rank,
        score_cume_dist,
        score_cume_dist_share_of_score_rank_2_score_quar,
```

```python
    .filter(F.col("grade_status").isNotNull())

        "id",
        "student_id",
        "course_id",
        "term",
        "score",
        "grade_status",
        "enrolled_at",
        (F.col("enrolled_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES")).alias("enrolled_at_plus_15m"),
        F.concat(F.col("term"), F.lit("#"), F.col("student_id").cast("string")).alias("term_ref"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("term")), 1, 2).alias("term_prefix"),

        F.ntile(4).over(Window.partitionBy("term").orderBy(F.col("score").desc(), "id")).alias("score_quartile"),
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.alpha_caliper,

    GROUP BY a.id, a.alpha_caliper, a.willow_dashboard
),
with_parent AS (
    -- Join onyx_sextants
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.alpha_caliper,
        s.willow_dashboard,
        l.interests AS listener_interests
    FROM in_window s
    JOIN onyx_sextants l ON l.id = s.alpha_caliper
)
SELECT
    id,
    alpha_caliper,
    willow_dashboard,
    listener_interests,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

in_window = (
    df_coastal_shipyards.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_coastal_shipyards.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.alpha_caliper") == F.col("a.alpha_caliper"))
        & (F.col("b.willow_dashboard") < F.col("a.willow_dashboard"))
        & (F.col("b.willow_dashboard") >= F.col("a.willow_dashboard") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
```

```python
    df_global_reactors.alias("c")
    .join(

        & F.col("c.claim_date").between(F.col("p.start_date"), F.coalesce(F.col("p.end_date"), F.lit("2099-12-31").cast("date"))),
        "left",
    )
    .select(

        "c.policy_id",
```

```sql
sessionized AS (

    FROM flagged
```

```sql
windowed AS (
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_tracks
    .filter((F.col("release_date") < F.lit("2025-03-08").cast("date")) & (~F.col("is_explicit")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "title",
        "duration_sec",
        "is_explicit",
        (F.floor(F.col("bpm") / 25) * 25).alias("bpm_bucket_src"),
        F.greatest(F.col("duration_sec"), F.col("bpm")).alias("greatest_duration_sec_bpm"),
    )
)

w_all_by_duration_sec = Window.orderBy("duration_sec", "id")
w_is_explicit_artist_id = Window.partitionBy("is_explicit", "artist_id")
with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("greatest_duration_sec_bpm") / F.nullif(F.sum("greatest_duration_sec_bpm").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("greatest_duration_sec_bpm_share_of_artist_id"),
        F.round(F.avg("bpm_bucket_src").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")), 2).alias("artist_id_avg_bpm_bucket_src"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_explicit").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("duration_sec_dense_rank"),
        F.nth_value("bpm_bucket_src", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc_nulls_first(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_bpm_bucket_src"),
        F.rank().over(w_all_by_duration_sec).alias("duration_sec_rank"),
        F.min("duration_sec").over(w_is_explicit_artist_id).alias("is_explicit_artist_id_min_duration_sec"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc_nulls_first())).alias("duration_sec_rank_2"),
        F.lead("duration_sec", 1, 0).over(Window.orderBy("duration_sec", "id")).alias("next_duration_sec"),
        F.max("bpm_bucket_src").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id")).alias("artist_id_max_bpm_bucket_src"),
        (F.col("duration_sec") - F.lag("duration_sec").over(w_all_by_duration_sec)).alias("duration_sec_change"),
        F.lag("duration_sec").over(Window.partitionBy("artist_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc_nulls_first(), "id")).alias("prev_duration_sec"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_explicit", "artist_id").orderBy("bpm_bucket_src", "id")).alias("bpm_bucket_src_dense_rank"),
    )
)

w_artist_id_is_explicit = Window.partitionBy("artist_id", "is_explicit")
ranked = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_explicit", "bpm_bucket_src_dense_rank").orderBy(F.col("is_explicit_artist_id_min_duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id")).alias("is_explicit_artist_id_min_duration_sec_dense_ran"),

        F.max("duration_sec").over(w_artist_id_is_explicit).alias("artist_id_is_explicit_max_duration_sec"),
    )
)

result = (
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.agent_id,
        a.solar_crate,

        SUM(b.requester_id) AS summit_paddock
    FROM stg_libretti a
    LEFT JOIN stg_libretti b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.solar_crate < a.solar_crate
     AND b.solar_crate >= a.solar_crate - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.solar_crate
),
agent_id_stats AS (
    -- Median summit_paddock per agent_id
    SELECT agent_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(summit_paddock, 0.5) AS median_prior_requester_id_7d
    FROM covered
    GROUP BY agent_id
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_prior_requester_id_7d,
        ROUND(s.summit_paddock - g.median_prior_requester_id_7d, 2) AS prior_requester_id_7d_minus_median
    FROM covered s
    JOIN agent_id_stats g ON g.agent_id = s.agent_id
    WHERE s.summit_paddock >= g.median_prior_requester_id_7d
),
with_details AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.solar_crate,
        s.prior_rows_7d,
        s.summit_paddock,
        s.median_prior_requester_id_7d,
        s.prior_requester_id_7d_minus_median,
        su.agent_name
    FROM above_average s
    LEFT JOIN ranches su ON su.id = s.agent_id AND su.team NOT IN ('Billing', 'Tech')
),
unique_rows AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per agent_id
    SELECT
        id,
        agent_id,
        solar_crate,
        prior_rows_7d,
        summit_paddock,
        median_prior_requester_id_7d,
        prior_requester_id_7d_minus_median,
        agent_name
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY prior_requester_id_7d_minus_median DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM with_details
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    df_payments
```

```python
        "session_mins",
        "session_started_at",
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.listener_id,

        SUM(b.lantern_flag) AS prior_ms_played_1d
    FROM propellers a

     AND b.played_at < a.played_at
     AND b.played_at >= a.played_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.listener_id, a.played_at
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        prior_ms_played_1d + prior_rows_1d AS prior_ms_played_1d_plus_prior_rows_1d
    FROM in_window
    WHERE prior_rows_1d >= 2
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    listener_id,
    prior_rows_1d,
    GROUPING(listener_id) AS is_total_listener_id,
    MIN(prior_rows_1d) AS valley_current,
    ROUND(AVG(prior_ms_played_1d_plus_prior_rows_1d), 2) AS avg_prior_ms_played_1d_plus_prior_rows_1d,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM annotated
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((listener_id, prior_rows_1d), (listener_id), (prior_rows_1d), ())
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.played_at") >= F.col("a.played_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",

    .groupBy("a.id", "a.listener_id", "a.played_at")
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY chimney_note, site_id ORDER BY read_at NULLS LAST, id), 3) AS read_at_percent_rank
    FROM matched
```

```python
        F.round(F.col("duration_sec") - F.avg("duration_sec").over(w_artist_id), 2).alias("duration_sec_vs_artist_id_avg"),
```

```python
    df_engine_cycles
    .select(
        "id",
        "aircraft_fleet_id",
        "check_type",
        "tech_license",
        "egt_margin_c",
        "cycle_cnt",
        "delivered_on",
        "tail_no",
        "is_aog",
        F.when(F.col("is_aog"), "yes").otherwise("no").alias("is_aog_label"),
        F.concat(F.col("check_type"), F.lit("#"), F.col("cycle_cnt").cast("string")).alias("check_type_ref"),
    )

outliers = (

    .join(tech_license_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.tech_license") == F.col("s.tech_license"), "inner")
```

```python
    df_western_inlets.alias("a")

        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
```

```sql
    FROM lines

    WHERE currency <> 'USD'

verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM lines s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.currency = k.currency

    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        val,

    FROM verified

        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY currency_count_val ASC) AS currency_count_val_cume_dist
    FROM scored
```

```sql
    FROM base_loans s

with_details_patron AS (

    SELECT s.*, p.copies_owned AS patron_copies_owned
    FROM with_counts s
    JOIN patrons p ON p.id = s.patron_no
    WHERE p.copies_owned > 3
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(loan_count / NULLIF(SUM(loan_count) OVER (PARTITION BY copies_owned), 0), 4) AS loan_count_share_of_copies_owned,

    FROM with_details_patron

    patron_no,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base_loans = (
    df_loans
    .filter((F.col("copies_owned") <= 9) & (F.to_date(F.col("checked_out_at")) < F.lit("2025-03-02").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "patron_no",
        "partner_kind",
        "copies_owned",
        "checked_out_at",
        (F.col("checked_out_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES")).alias("checked_out_at_plus_15m"),
        (F.floor(F.col("copies_owned") / 2) * 2).alias("copies_owned_bucket"),
        F.date_trunc("year", F.col("checked_out_at")).alias("checked_out_at_year"),
    )
)

loan_stats = (
    df_loans
    .groupBy("patron_no")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("loan_count"), F.count("*").alias("loan_count_2"))
)

with_counts = (
    base_loans.alias("s")
    .join(loan_stats.alias("l"), F.col("l.patron_no") == F.col("s.patron_no"), "left")
    .select(
```

```sql
    select

    from accounts
    where balance >= 60000

scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        opened_date_plus_months,
        resolved_status,
        last_value(balance, true) over w_running as last_known_balance,
        lead(balance, 2) over (partition by customer_id order by balance, id) as next_balance,
        row_number() over (partition by status order by balance, id) as row_seq,
        sum(balance) over (partition by status, account_type order by opened_date_plus_months, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_balance,
        percent_rank() over w_recent as balance_percent_rank
    from filtered
    where balance > 68000
    window w_running as (partition by status order by opened_date_plus_months, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row), w_recent as (partition by customer_id, status order by balance)
),
kept as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from scored s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from transactions c
            where c.account_id = s.id
              and hour(c.txn_time) between 7 and 13
        )
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select

        opened_date_plus_months,

        row_seq,

        balance_percent_rank,
        row_number() over (order by balance_percent_rank desc, id) as row_seq_2,
        lead(balance_percent_rank, 2) over (order by cumulative_balance, id) as next_balance_percent_rank
    from kept
)

    round(avg(next_balance_percent_rank), 2) as avg_next_balance_percent_rank,

    sum(balance_percent_rank) as total_balance_percent_rank,
    max(balance_percent_rank) as max_balance_percent_rank,
    grouping_id() as grouping_id
from enriched
```

```sql
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(agent_id) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d)) AS distinct_agent_id_in_prior_rows_1d
    FROM covered

qualified AS (

with_counts AS (
```

```python
        "scanned_at",
    )
)

    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_session_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_scanned_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("scanned_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_scanned_at")) / 60 > 30), 1).otherwise(0))

)
```

```python
        "merchant_txn_type_key",
        "balance",
        "account_type",
        F.max("balance").over(w_recent).alias("running_max_balance"),
        F.min("balance").over(w_recent).alias("running_min_balance"),
        F.avg("balance").over(w_recent).alias("running_avg_balance"),
        F.lag("amount", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "account_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")).alias("prev_amount"),
    )
)
```

```python
w_grp = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "txn_time"), "account_id").orderBy("session_id", "id")

gaps = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("txn_time") - F.lag("txn_time").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

enriched = (
    sessions_transactions
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        "is_new_session",
        "session_id",
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("merchant"))), 4).alias("amount_share"),
        F.avg("session_id").over(Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)).alias("session_id_avg_2_prior"),
    )
)

metrics = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("amount_share").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "merchant").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)).alias("amount_share_max_30d"),

    )
)

enriched_transactions = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("session_id").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "merchant").orderBy("is_new_session", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)).alias("session_id_avg_5_prior"),
        F.ntile(3).over(Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("next_amount_share", "id")).alias("next_amount_share_bucket"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_running).alias("is_new_session_bucket"),
        F.avg("amount").over(Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("amount_avg_2"),

        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("session_id_avg_5_prior").asc_nulls_first())).alias("session_id_avg_5_prior_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "merchant",
        "session_id",
        "next_amount_share_bucket",
        "amount_avg_2",
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window
```

```python
    df_drafts.alias("a")
    .join(

        (F.col("b.chandler_grade") == F.col("a.chandler_grade"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.chandler_grade", "a.enrolled_at")

        F.sum("b.score").alias("cobalt_gallerie"),
    )
)

enrollment_stats = (
    df_drafts
    .groupBy("chandler_grade")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("term").isNotNull(), 1)).alias("enrollment_term_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("enrollment_count"),
    )
)

with_counts = (
    in_window.alias("s")
    .join(enrollment_stats.alias("e"), F.col("e.chandler_grade") == F.col("s.chandler_grade"), "left")

latest = (

    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("chandler_grade").orderBy(F.col("prior_rows_7d").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

labeled = latest.withColumn("enrolled_at_label", F.date_format(F.col("enrolled_at"), "MMM yyyy"))

result = (

        "enrollment_term_count", "enrollment_count", "chandler_grade",
    )
    .agg(
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
        F.min("enrolled_at").alias("first_enrolled_at"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.max("enrollment_term_count").alias("max_enrollment_term_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(
```

```sql
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY game_mode ORDER BY round_ended_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(round_ended_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(round_ended_ts))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

    CASE WHEN n_game_mode_squad >= 7 THEN 'large' WHEN n_game_mode_squad >= 4 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS n_game_mode_squad_tier
```

```python
        "game_mode",

        "round_ended_ts",
        F.year(F.col("round_ended_ts")).alias("round_ended_ts_year"),
    )
)

)
```

```sql
        stop_label,
        rider_cnt,
        visited_at
    FROM depots

with_prev AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(visited_at) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label ORDER BY visited_at, id) AS prev_visited_at
    FROM base
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 2 hours)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_visited_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(visited_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_visited_at)) / 60 > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY stop_label ORDER BY visited_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        stop_label,
        session_id,
        MIN(visited_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(visited_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(rider_cnt) AS session_rider_cnt,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(visited_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(visited_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY stop_label, session_id
)
-- Subtotals with CUBE
SELECT
    stop_label,
    n_events,
    session_id,
    GROUPING(stop_label) AS is_total_stop_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT stop_label) AS distinct_stop_labels,
    ROUND(STDDEV(n_events), 2) AS stddev_n_events
FROM sessions
```

```python
flagged = (

    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_visited_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("visited_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_visited_at")) / 60 > 120), 1).otherwise(0))
```

```python
    df_payments
```

```sql
),
per_group AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        weathervane_ref,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at) AS shutter_tally,
        site_id,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(urban_corridor, 0.5) AS median_prior_voltage_12h,
        ROUND(AVG(weathervane_ref), 2) AS avg_prior_rows_12h
    FROM in_window
    WHERE urban_corridor > 306.2
    GROUP BY weathervane_ref, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), site_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT weathervane_ref, shutter_tally, site_id
FROM per_group
ORDER BY shutter_tally DESC, weathervane_ref DESC
```

```python
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
```

```sql
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY adjuster_id) AS rows_in_adjuster_id,
```

```python
    df_ochre_buoys
    .filter(F.col("region").isNull())
    .withColumn("years_since_opened_date", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "opened_date") / 365.25))
    .withColumn("city_tot_eff_prefix", F.substring("city_tot_eff", 1, 4))
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("region", "city_tot_eff").orderBy("sqft")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

with_latest = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_mural_snorkels.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.units").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)

        "years_since_opened_date",
        "store_sale_revenue",
        F.ntile(5).over(Window.orderBy("store_sale_revenue", "id")).alias("store_sale_revenue_bucket"),
        F.last("store_sale_revenue", ignorenulls=True).over(w_recent).alias("last_known_store_sale_revenue"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("years_since_opened_date") >= 72, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("years_since_opened_date_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("last_known_store_sale_revenue") >= 4200, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last_known_store_sale_revenue_tier"),
```

```sql
WITH desktop_monthly AS (
    -- desktop rows per played_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at) AS played_at_month, COUNT(*) AS desktop_count, ROUND(AVG(ms_played), 2) AS desktop_avg_ms_played
    FROM plays
    WHERE device = 'desktop'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at)
),
phone_monthly AS (
    -- phone rows per played_at_month
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at) AS played_at_month, COUNT(*) AS phone_count, SUM(ms_played) AS phone_total_ms_played
    FROM plays
    WHERE device = 'phone'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', played_at)
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.played_at_month, b.played_at_month) AS played_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.desktop_count, 0) AS desktop_count,
    a.desktop_avg_ms_played,
    COALESCE(b.phone_count, 0) AS phone_count,
    b.phone_total_ms_played,
    COALESCE(a.desktop_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.phone_count, 0) AS desktop_count_minus_phone_count
FROM desktop_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN phone_monthly b
  ON a.played_at_month = b.played_at_month
ORDER BY played_at_month
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

desktop_monthly = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("device") == "desktop")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "played_at").alias("played_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("desktop_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("ms_played"), 2).alias("desktop_avg_ms_played"),
    )
)

phone_monthly = (
    df_plays
    .filter(F.col("device") == "phone")
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("month", "played_at").alias("played_at_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("phone_count"),
        F.sum("ms_played").alias("phone_total_ms_played"),
    )
)

result = (
    desktop_monthly.alias("a")
    .join(phone_monthly.alias("b"), F.col("a.played_at_month") == F.col("b.played_at_month"), "full")
    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.played_at_month"), F.col("b.played_at_month")).alias("played_at_month"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.desktop_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("desktop_count"),
        F.col("a.desktop_avg_ms_played"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("b.phone_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("phone_count"),
        F.col("b.phone_total_ms_played"),
        (F.coalesce(F.col("a.desktop_count"), F.lit(0)) - F.coalesce(F.col("b.phone_count"), F.lit(0))).alias("desktop_count_minus_phone_count"),
    )
    .orderBy("played_at_month")
)
```

```sql
        LAST_VALUE(bpm) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY duration_sec_bucket_seq ORDER BY bpm DESC, id, mood ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_bpm,
        duration_sec_bucket - LAG(duration_sec_bucket) OVER w_duration_sec_bucket_seq_by_b_3 AS duration_sec_bucket_change,
        ROUND(duration_sec_bucket_rank - AVG(duration_sec_bucket_rank) OVER w_duration_sec_bucket_rank, 2) AS duration_sec_bucket_rank_vs_duration_sec_bucket_,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_duration_sec_bucket_seq_by_b_4 AS bpm_dense_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_duration_sec_bucket_seq_by_b_3 AS (PARTITION BY duration_sec_bucket_seq ORDER BY bpm DESC, id, mood), w_duration_sec_bucket_rank AS (PARTITION BY duration_sec_bucket_rank), w_duration_sec_bucket_seq_by_b_4 AS (PARTITION BY duration_sec_bucket_seq ORDER BY bpm DESC)
),
with_children AS (
    -- One row per play
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.artist_id,
        s.bpm,
        s.duration_sec_bucket,
        s.mood,
        s.duration_sec_bucket_seq,
        s.last_track_release_date_rank,

        p.source AS play_source,
        p.played_at AS play_played_at
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN plays p ON p.track_id = s.id
),

)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    bpm,
    duration_sec_bucket,
    mood,
    duration_sec_bucket_seq,
    duration_sec_bucket_sum_4,
    duration_sec_bucket_rank_vs_duration_sec_bucket_,
    bpm_dense_rank,
    play_id,
    play_ms_played,
    play_source,
    play_played_at,

FROM with_activity
ORDER BY bpm_dense_rank, duration_sec_bucket_sum_4 DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_tracks
    .filter(F.col("release_date") >= F.lit("2024-11-14").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "is_explicit",
        "bpm",
        "moods",
        (F.floor(F.col("duration_sec") / 50) * 50).alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
    )
)

flattened = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "artist_id",
        "is_explicit",
        "bpm",
        "duration_sec_bucket",
        F.explode("moods").alias("mood"),
    )
)

track_stats = (
    df_tracks
    .groupBy("artist_id")
    .agg(F.max("release_date").alias("last_track_release_date"))
)

with_stats = (
    flattened.alias("s")
    .join(track_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.artist_id") == F.col("s.artist_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "t.last_track_release_date")
)

with_windows = (
    with_stats
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_bucket").asc_nulls_last(), "id", "mood")).alias("duration_sec_bucket_seq"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("is_explicit").orderBy(F.col("last_track_release_date").desc(), "id", "mood")).alias("last_track_release_date_rank"),
        F.sum("duration_sec_bucket").over(Window.partitionBy("mood", F.date_trunc("month", "last_track_release_date")).orderBy("duration_sec_bucket", "id", "mood").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("duration_sec_bucket_sum_4"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_bucket").asc_nulls_last(), "id", "mood")).alias("duration_sec_bucket_rank"),
    )
)

w_duration_sec_bucket_seq_by_b_3 = Window.partitionBy("duration_sec_bucket_seq").orderBy(F.col("bpm").desc(), "id", "mood")
w_duration_sec_bucket_rank = Window.partitionBy("duration_sec_bucket_rank")
w_duration_sec_bucket_seq_by_b_4 = Window.partitionBy("duration_sec_bucket_seq").orderBy(F.col("bpm").desc())
ranked = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("last_track_release_date_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("duration_sec_bucket_rank")).alias("duration_sec_bucket_rank_max_last_track_release_"),
        F.nth_value("bpm", 2).over(Window.partitionBy("duration_sec_bucket_seq").orderBy(F.col("bpm").desc(), "id", "mood").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("second_bpm"),
        F.last("bpm", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("duration_sec_bucket_seq").orderBy(F.col("bpm").desc(), "id", "mood").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_bpm"),
        (F.col("duration_sec_bucket") - F.lag("duration_sec_bucket").over(w_duration_sec_bucket_seq_by_b_3)).alias("duration_sec_bucket_change"),
        F.round(F.col("duration_sec_bucket_rank") - F.avg("duration_sec_bucket_rank").over(w_duration_sec_bucket_rank), 2).alias("duration_sec_bucket_rank_vs_duration_sec_bucket_"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_duration_sec_bucket_seq_by_b_4).alias("bpm_dense_rank"),
    )
)

with_children = (
    ranked.alias("s")
    .join(df_plays.alias("p"), F.col("p.track_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.artist_id",
        "s.bpm",
        "s.duration_sec_bucket",
        "s.mood",
        "s.duration_sec_bucket_seq",
        "s.last_track_release_date_rank",
        "s.duration_sec_bucket_sum_4",
        "s.duration_sec_bucket_rank_vs_duration_sec_bucket_",
        "s.bpm_dense_rank",
        F.col("p.id").alias("play_id"),
        F.col("p.listener_id").alias("play_listener_id"),
        F.col("p.ms_played").alias("play_ms_played"),
        F.col("p.source").alias("play_source"),
        F.col("p.played_at").alias("play_played_at"),
    )
)

with_activity = (
    with_children.alias("s")
    .join(df_plays.alias("p"), F.col("p.listener_id") == F.col("s.play_listener_id"), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    with_activity
    .select(
        "id",
        "bpm",
        "duration_sec_bucket",
        "mood",
        "duration_sec_bucket_seq",
        "duration_sec_bucket_sum_4",
        "duration_sec_bucket_rank_vs_duration_sec_bucket_",
        "bpm_dense_rank",
        "play_id",
        "play_ms_played",
        "play_source",
        "play_played_at",
        F.abs(F.col("play_ms_played") - 218129).alias("play_ms_played_distance"),
        F.initcap(F.trim(F.col("play_source"))).alias("play_source_clean"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("bpm_dense_rank").asc(),
        F.col("duration_sec_bucket_sum_4").desc(),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.site_id,
        a.read_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_3d,
        SUM(b.kwh) AS prior_kwh_3d
    FROM spindles a
    LEFT JOIN spindles b
      ON b.site_id = a.site_id
     AND b.read_at < a.read_at
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at) AS indigo_locker,
        site_id,
        prior_rows_3d,
        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_3d), 2) AS stddev_prior_rows_3d,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_kwh_3d), 2) AS granarie_mark,
        MIN(prior_kwh_3d) AS min_prior_kwh_3d,
        ROUND(AVG(prior_kwh_3d), 2) AS avg_prior_kwh_3d
    FROM in_window
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', read_at), site_id, prior_rows_3d
),
annotated AS (
    -- Derive helper columns
    SELECT
        indigo_locker,
        site_id,
        prior_rows_3d,
        distinct_ids,
        granarie_mark,
        min_prior_kwh_3d,
        indigo_locker + INTERVAL 15 MINUTES AS read_at_month_plus_15m
    FROM summary
)
SELECT
    indigo_locker,
    prior_rows_3d,
    distinct_ids,
    granarie_mark,
    min_prior_kwh_3d,
    read_at_month_plus_15m,
    ABS(distinct_ids - 7) AS distinct_ids_distance
FROM annotated
ORDER BY prior_rows_3d DESC NULLS FIRST, granarie_mark DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

in_window = (
    df_spindles.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_spindles.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.site_id") == F.col("a.site_id"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") < F.col("a.read_at"))
        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.kwh").alias("prior_kwh_3d"),
    )
)

summary = (
    in_window
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("month", "read_at").alias("indigo_locker"),
        "site_id",
        "prior_rows_3d",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("prior_rows_3d"), 2).alias("stddev_prior_rows_3d"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.stddev("prior_kwh_3d"), 2).alias("granarie_mark"),
        F.min("prior_kwh_3d").alias("min_prior_kwh_3d"),

annotated = (

    .select(
        "indigo_locker",
        "site_id",
        "prior_rows_3d",
        "distinct_ids",
        "granarie_mark",
        "min_prior_kwh_3d",
        (F.col("indigo_locker") + F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES")).alias("read_at_month_plus_15m"),
    )
)

result = (

        "prior_rows_3d",
        "distinct_ids",
        "granarie_mark",
        "min_prior_kwh_3d",
        "read_at_month_plus_15m",
        F.abs(F.col("distinct_ids") - 7).alias("distinct_ids_distance"),
    )
    .orderBy(
```

```python
base = (
    df_pharmacy_fills
    .filter((F.col("plan_kind") == "chronic") & (F.col("bmi_value") >= 20.1))
    .select(
        "id",
        "care_plan_id",
        "ward_code",
        "plan_kind",
        "plan_start_day",
    )
)

w_all_by_plan_start_day = Window.orderBy("plan_start_day", "id")
windowed = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("plan_start_day", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("plan_start_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_plan_start_day"),
        F.lag("plan_start_day", 3).over(Window.orderBy("plan_start_day", "id")).alias("prev3_plan_start_day"),
        F.row_number().over(Window.orderBy("plan_start_day", "id")).alias("plan_start_day_seq"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy("plan_start_day")).alias("plan_start_day_rank"),
        F.lag("plan_start_day", 2).over(Window.orderBy("plan_start_day", "id")).alias("prev2_plan_start_day"),

)

top_per_group = windowed.filter(F.col("plan_start_day_rank") == 1)

with_trends = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("plan_start_day", 2).over(Window.orderBy("prev2_plan_start_day", "id")).alias("next2_plan_start_day"),

        F.first("plan_start_day_percent_rank").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("plan_start_day_percent_rank").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_plan_start_day_percent_rank"),
        F.lead("first_known_plan_start_day").over(Window.orderBy("prev2_plan_start_day", "id")).alias("next_first_known_plan_start_day"),
    )
)
```

```sql
    WHERE level != 'DEBUG'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY key) key_min_latency_ms,
```

```python
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_share").desc_nulls_last())
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("host")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "v"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    lines
    .select("id", "level")
    .exceptAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms") > 2010)
        .select("id", "level")
    )
)

    lines
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("level") != "DEBUG")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("service", "level").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc())).alias("latency_ms_cume_dist"),
        F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc())).alias("latency_ms_cume_dist_2"),
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("key"))), 4).alias("latency_ms_share"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("key_min_latency_ms", F.min("latency_ms").over(Window.partitionBy("key")))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_cume_dist_2_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("host", "level").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_cume_dist_2").desc())))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_cume_dist_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_cume_dist").desc())))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_ordered).alias("latency_ms_share_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms_dense_rank") / F.sum("latency_ms_dense_rank").over(Window.partitionBy("service"))), 4).alias("latency_ms_dense_rank_share"),
        F.count("latency_ms_cume_dist_2_dense_rank").over(w_hist).alias("host_count_latency_ms_cume_dist_2_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy("level", "key")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "auth", 1)).alias("auth_rows"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("key")).alias("key_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", 1)).alias("billing_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", F.col("host_count_latency_ms_cume_dist_2_dense_rank")).otherwise(0)).alias("billing_host_count_latency_ms_cume_dist_2_dense_rank"),

)
```

```sql
    FROM eateries

with_prev AS (

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (

    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY seat_zone ORDER BY served_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        seat_zone,
        burst_id,
        MIN(served_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(served_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(served_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(served_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY seat_zone, burst_id
),
per_group AS (
    -- Summarise per group
    SELECT
        YEAR(session_start) AS session_start_year,
        burst_id,
        SUM(burst_id) AS total_burst_id,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM per_session
    GROUP BY YEAR(session_start), burst_id
)
SELECT
    session_start_year,
    total_burst_id,
    GREATEST(session_start_year, total_burst_id) AS greatest_session_start_year_total_burst_id
FROM per_group
```

```python
        "served_at",
        "dish_title",
```

```sql
WITH joined_ranges AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.sku_id,
        a.solar_agent,
        COUNT(b.id) AS saddle_amt,
        SUM(b.qty) AS prior_qty_12h
    FROM timbers a
    LEFT JOIN timbers b
      ON b.sku_id = a.sku_id
     AND b.solar_agent < a.solar_agent
     AND b.solar_agent >= a.solar_agent - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.solar_agent
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', solar_agent) AS moved_at_year
    FROM joined_ranges
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id, saddle_amt ORDER BY saddle_amt, id) AS solar_alarm,
        saddle_amt - LAG(saddle_amt) OVER w_sku_id_prior_rows_12h_by_pri AS prior_rows_12h_change,
        LEAD(saddle_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id, saddle_amt ORDER BY saddle_amt, id) AS next_prior_rows_12h,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(moved_at_year) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(moved_at_year) OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id, saddle_amt ORDER BY saddle_amt, id))) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_moved_at_year,
        LAG(prior_qty_12h) OVER (PARTITION BY sku_id, saddle_amt ORDER BY saddle_amt, id) AS prev_prior_qty_12h
    FROM annotated
    WINDOW w_sku_id_prior_rows_12h_by_pri AS (PARTITION BY sku_id, saddle_amt ORDER BY saddle_amt, id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    sku_id,
    solar_agent,
    saddle_amt,
    prior_qty_12h,
    moved_at_year,
    solar_alarm,
    prior_rows_12h_change,
    next_prior_rows_12h,
    prev_prior_qty_12h
FROM sequenced
ORDER BY saddle_amt, id
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

joined_ranges = (
    df_timbers.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_timbers.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.sku_id") == F.col("a.sku_id"))
        & (F.col("b.solar_agent") < F.col("a.solar_agent"))
        & (F.col("b.solar_agent") >= F.col("a.solar_agent") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.solar_agent")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("saddle_amt"),
        F.sum("b.qty").alias("prior_qty_12h"),
    )
)

annotated = joined_ranges.select("*", F.date_trunc("year", F.col("solar_agent")).alias("moved_at_year"))

w_sku_id_prior_rows_12h_by_pri = Window.partitionBy("sku_id", "saddle_amt").orderBy("saddle_amt", "id")
sequenced = (
    annotated
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id", "saddle_amt").orderBy("saddle_amt", "id")).alias("solar_alarm"),
        (F.col("saddle_amt") - F.lag("saddle_amt").over(w_sku_id_prior_rows_12h_by_pri)).alias("prior_rows_12h_change"),
        F.lead("saddle_amt").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id", "saddle_amt").orderBy("saddle_amt", "id")).alias("next_prior_rows_12h"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("moved_at_year") - F.unix_timestamp(F.lag("moved_at_year").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id", "saddle_amt").orderBy("saddle_amt", "id")))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_since_prev_moved_at_year"),
        F.lag("prior_qty_12h").over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id", "saddle_amt").orderBy("saddle_amt", "id")).alias("prev_prior_qty_12h"),
    )
)

result = (
    sequenced
    .select(
        "id",
        "sku_id",
        "solar_agent",
        "saddle_amt",
        "prior_qty_12h",
        "moved_at_year",
        "solar_alarm",
        "prior_rows_12h_change",
        "next_prior_rows_12h",
        "prev_prior_qty_12h",
    )
    .orderBy("saddle_amt", F.col("id").asc())
)
```

```sql
),
```
```sql
without_matches AS (
```

```sql
unique_rows AS (

        FROM without_matches
    ) ranked

),
labeled AS (

    SELECT

    FROM unique_rows
    WHERE holder_name_prefix IS NOT NULL

screened AS (

        )

FROM (
    SELECT joined_on, joined_on_quarter, segment, risk_score_filled
    FROM screened
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(risk_score_filled) AS avg_v, MAX(risk_score_filled) AS max_v
    FOR segment IN ('SME', 'VIP', 'RETAIL')
)
ORDER BY joined_on, joined_on_quarter
```

```python
valid_holders = (
    df_policyholders
    .filter(F.col("joined_on").between(F.lit("2024-02-04").cast("date"), F.lit("2025-10-17").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "holder_name",
        "region_pri",
        "risk_score",
        "joined_on",
        "segment",
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("region_pri")), 1, 3).alias("region_pri_prefix"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("holder_name")), 1, 3).alias("holder_name_prefix"),

)

filtered = (
    valid_holders.alias("s")
    .join(df_policies.alias("p"), (F.col("p.holder_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("p.status").isin("LAPSED", "CANCELLED")) & (F.year(F.col("p.start_date")) == 2024), "left_anti")
```

```sql
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cost, id) AS seq_no,
        LEAD(cost, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(launch_date), category ORDER BY price, id) AS next_cost,
        SUM(stock_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, category ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_stock_qty
    FROM valid
),
metrics_products AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        brand,
        cost,
        launch_date,
        supplier_id,
        corr_price_cost,
        next_cost,
        running_stock_qty,
        MAX(corr_price_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY category, brand ORDER BY running_stock_qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_corr_price_cost,
        AVG(corr_price_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY category, brand ORDER BY running_stock_qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_corr_price_cost,
        SUM(corr_price_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY category, brand ORDER BY running_stock_qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_corr_price_cost,
        AVG(seq_no) OVER (ORDER BY corr_price_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seq_no_avg_5
    FROM metrics
),
with_latest AS (
    -- Latest matching store_sale per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT

        s.running_stock_qty,
        s.running_max_corr_price_cost,

        s.seq_no_avg_5,
```

```sql
ranked AS (

        amount,
        paid_at
```

```sql
    GROUP BY a.id, a.sku_id, a.moved_at

    FROM with_children

    SELECT

    FROM with_windows s

FROM (

    FROM with_counts

PIVOT (

    FOR move_operator IN ('op_dew', 'op_ann', 'op_eve')
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 3 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_3d"),
        F.sum("b.qty").alias("prior_qty_3d"),
    )
)

with_children = (
    joined_ranges.alias("s")
    .join(df_binders.alias("st"), (F.col("st.sku_id") == F.col("s.sku_id")) & (F.col("st.unit_price") < 289.7), "inner")
    .select(

        "s.sku_id",
        "s.prior_rows_3d",

    )
)

    .groupBy("sku_id")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(~F.col("move_type").isin("TRANSFER", "INBOUND"), 1)).alias("move_move_type_count"),
        F.min("moved_at").alias("shrine_rank"),
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_frescoes_v2.alias("e")
    .join(
        df_tbl_basins.alias("t"),
        (F.col("t.id") == F.col("e.sensor_code"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") >= F.col("t.opened_at"))
        & (F.col("e.event_at") <= F.coalesce(F.col("t.closed_at"), F.col("t.opened_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 2 DAYS"))),
        "inner",
    )
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.sensor_code",
        "e.event_at",
        "e.event_type",
        "t.priority",
        "t.agent_id",
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp("e.event_at") - F.unix_timestamp("t.opened_at")) / 3600, 2).alias("gyroscope_score"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce(F.col("event_type"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("event_type_or_unknown"),
    )
)

with_windows = (

    .select(

        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "gyroscope_score",
        "event_type_or_unknown",

    )
)

    .drop("overall_max_first_hours_since_open")
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("event_type")
    .pivot("event_type_or_unknown", ["assigned", "UNKNOWN"])

)
```

```sql
    MAX(polar_granarie) AS weathervane_mark,
    ROUND(SUM(derrick_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(prior_voltage_3d), 0), 3) AS prior_rows_3d_to_prior_voltage_3d_ratio
FROM screened
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((derrick_qty, site_id), (derrick_qty), (site_id))
```

```sql
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT

    GROUP BY a.id, a.tram_code, a.bulletin_rank
),
screened AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM in_window
    WHERE prior_rows_1d > (SELECT AVG(prior_rows_1d) FROM in_window)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    tram_code,
    bulletin_rank,
    prior_rows_1d,
    prior_unit_price_1d,
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_promo_runs
    .filter((F.col("promo_lift_percent") < 29.3) & (F.col("adj_promo_start_day") < F.lit("2025-09-03").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "outlet_id",
        "audit_result",
        "facings",
        "adj_promo_start_day",
        "flag_is_franchise",
    )
)

w_audit_result_flag_is_franchi = Window.partitionBy("audit_result", "flag_is_franchise").orderBy(F.col("adj_promo_start_day").desc(), "id")
w_outlet_id_by_facings_2 = Window.partitionBy("outlet_id").orderBy("facings", "id")
w_outlet_id = Window.partitionBy("outlet_id")
w_outlet_id_by_facings = Window.partitionBy("outlet_id").orderBy(F.col("facings").desc(), "id")
w_audit_result_flag_is_franchi_2 = Window.partitionBy("audit_result", "flag_is_franchise")
metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("facings", 3, 0).over(w_audit_result_flag_is_franchi).alias("next3_facings"),
        F.round(F.avg("facings").over(Window.partitionBy("outlet_id")), 2).alias("outlet_id_avg_facings"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("audit_result").orderBy("facings", "id")).alias("facings_rank"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy("audit_result").orderBy("facings")), 3).alias("facings_cume_dist"),
        (F.col("facings") - F.lag("facings").over(Window.partitionBy("outlet_id").orderBy(F.col("facings").desc(), "id"))).alias("facings_change"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(w_outlet_id_by_facings_2), 3).alias("facings_cume_dist_2"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("audit_result").over(w_outlet_id)).alias("distinct_audit_result_in_outlet_id"),
        F.datediff(F.col("adj_promo_start_day"), F.lag("adj_promo_start_day").over(w_outlet_id_by_facings)).alias("days_since_prev_adj_promo_start_day"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_audit_result_flag_is_franchi_2).alias("rows_in_audit_result_flag_is_franchise"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("audit_result").orderBy("facings")), 3).alias("facings_percent_rank"),
        F.round(F.col("facings") - F.avg("facings").over(w_outlet_id), 2).alias("facings_vs_outlet_id_avg"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("outlet_id").orderBy("facings")).alias("facings_dense_rank"),
        F.round(F.avg("facings").over(Window.partitionBy("outlet_id").orderBy("facings", "id").rowsBetween(-1, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("facings_avg_2"),
        F.first("facings").over(Window.partitionBy("audit_result", "flag_is_franchise").orderBy(F.col("adj_promo_start_day").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_facings"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("outlet_id").over(Window.partitionBy("audit_result", "flag_is_franchise"))).alias("distinct_outlet_id_in_audit_result_flag_is_franc"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("adj_promo_start_day") < F.lit("2025-01-17").cast("date"))
    .groupBy("audit_result", "facings_rank")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.stddev("days_since_prev_adj_promo_start_day"), 2).alias("stddev_days_since_prev_adj_promo_start_day"),

        F.round(F.sum("facings_cume_dist_2"), 2).alias("total_facings_cume_dist_2"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
)

w_facings_rank_cnt_by_n_flag_i = Window.partitionBy("facings_rank", "cnt").orderBy(F.col("n_flag_is_franchise_true").asc_nulls_last(), "audit_result", "facings_rank")
metrics_2 = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("total_facings_cume_dist_2").over(Window.partitionBy("facings_rank", "cnt").orderBy(F.col("n_flag_is_franchise_true").asc_nulls_last(), "audit_result", "facings_rank")).alias("next_total_facings_cume_dist_2"),
        F.first("n_flag_is_franchise_true").over(Window.partitionBy("facings_rank", "cnt").orderBy(F.col("n_flag_is_franchise_true").asc_nulls_last(), "audit_result", "facings_rank").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("first_n_flag_is_franchise_true"),
        F.round(F.avg("n_flag_is_franchise_true").over(Window.partitionBy("facings_rank", "cnt").orderBy(F.col("n_flag_is_franchise_true").asc_nulls_last(), "audit_result", "facings_rank").rowsBetween(-6, -1)), 2).alias("n_flag_is_franchise_true_avg_6_prior"),
        F.rank().over(w_facings_rank_cnt_by_n_flag_i).alias("n_flag_is_franchise_true_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics_2
    .select(
        "audit_result",
        "facings_rank",
        "stddev_days_since_prev_adj_promo_start_day",
        "n_flag_is_franchise_true",
        "total_facings_vs_outlet_id_avg",
        "total_facings_cume_dist_2",
        "cnt",
        "next_total_facings_cume_dist_2",
        "n_flag_is_franchise_true_avg_6_prior",
        "n_flag_is_franchise_true_rank",
        (F.col("facings_rank") + F.col("n_flag_is_franchise_true")).alias("facings_rank_plus_n_flag_is_franchise_true"),
        F.when(F.col("cnt") >= 9, "large").when(F.col("cnt") >= 6, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("cnt_tier"),
    )

)
```

```sql
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE move_type = 'INBOUND'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', moved_at)
)
-- Combine both sides; keys missing on one side get zeros
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.moved_at_month, b.moved_at_month) AS moved_at_month,
    COALESCE(a.outbound_count, 0) AS outbound_count,
    a.outbound_total_qty,
    COALESCE(b.inbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count,
    b.inbound_avg_qty,
    COALESCE(a.outbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.inbound_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM outbound_monthly a
FULL OUTER JOIN inbound_monthly b
  ON a.moved_at_month = b.moved_at_month
ORDER BY moved_at_month
```

```python
    df_stock_moves
    .filter(F.col("move_type") == "OUTBOUND")

        F.sum("qty").alias("outbound_total_qty"),

    )
)

    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.moved_at_month"), F.col("b.moved_at_month")).alias("moved_at_month"),
```

```sql
        MAX(closed_at) AS last_closed_at,

    FROM recent

with_activity AS (

ranked AS (

scored AS (
```

```python
        "agent_id",

        "closed_at",
        "channel",
        "csat",
        "tags",
        F.concat(F.col("channel"), F.lit("#"), F.col("csat").cast("string")).alias("channel_ref"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.col("closed_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.col("opened_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("minutes_opened_at_to_closed_at"),

    .groupBy(F.to_date("closed_at").alias("closed_at_day"))
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "phone", F.col("requester_id")).otherwise(0)).alias("requester_id_channel_phone"),
        F.max("closed_at").alias("last_closed_at"),
        F.countDistinct("channel").alias("distinct_channels"),

with_activity = (

w_last_closed_at_year_distinct = Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_closed_at"), "distinct_channels")
ranked = (
    with_activity
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.avg("requester_id_channel_phone").over(w_last_closed_at_year_distinct), 2).alias("last_closed_at_year_distinct_channels_avg_reques"),
        F.lead("closed_at_day", 2).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("requester_id_channel_phone").desc(), "closed_at_day")).alias("next2_closed_at_day"),
    )
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "closed_at_day",
        "requester_id_channel_phone",
        "distinct_channels",
        F.date_format(F.col("closed_at_day"), "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("closed_at_day_label"),
    )
)

screened = (
    scored
    .crossJoin(scored.agg(F.avg("requester_id_channel_phone").alias("overall_avg_requester_id_channel_phone")))
    .filter(F.col("requester_id_channel_phone") > F.col("overall_avg_requester_id_channel_phone"))

        F.lag("closed_at_day", 3).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("distinct_channels").desc(), "closed_at_day")).alias("prev3_closed_at_day"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupingSets(
        [["prev2_distinct_channels", "distinct_channels"], ["prev2_distinct_channels"]],
        "prev2_distinct_channels", "distinct_channels",
    )
    .agg(F.max("closed_at_day").alias("last_closed_at_day"))
```

```sql
    SELECT
        d.city,
        d.country,
        src.account_type,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        SUM(src.balance) AS total_balance
    FROM accounts src
    JOIN customers d ON src.customer_id = d.id
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.city, d.country, src.account_type), (d.city))
)
SELECT
    country,
    account_type,
    CASE WHEN account_type RLIKE '^(CREDIT|CHECKING)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS account_type_zone
FROM dim_totals
```

```python
        F.col("d.country").alias("country"),
```

```sql
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, coalesce(humidity, 0) as humidity_filled
    from device_readings
    where reading_ts > date '2025-09-01'
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by device_code order by humidity_filled desc nulls last, id asc) as dedup_rank
        from valid
    ) t
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
ranked_device_readings as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        firmware,
        dedup_rank
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by device_code order by temp_c desc, id asc) as latest_rank
        from ranked
    ) x
    where latest_rank = 1
),
with_prev as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts asc, id asc) as prev_reading_ts
    from ranked_device_readings
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_reading_ts is null or reading_ts > prev_reading_ts + interval '30' minute then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from with_prev
),
sessions_device_readings as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        dedup_rank,
        sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from with_gaps
),
flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when reading_ts - lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts asc, id asc) > interval 20 minutes then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from sessions_device_readings
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from flagged
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        is_new_session,
        min(burst_id) over (partition by device_code order by dedup_rank asc, id asc rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_min_burst_id,
        avg(burst_id) over (partition by device_code order by dedup_rank asc, id asc rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_avg_burst_id,
        count(burst_id) over (partition by device_code order by dedup_rank asc, id asc rows between 2 preceding and current row) as last3_count_burst_id,
        rank() over (partition by device_code order by island_id desc) as island_id_rank
    from sessionized
    where burst_id < 7
),
ranked_device_readings_2 as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by device_code order by last3_avg_burst_id desc, id asc) as latest_rank
        from with_windows
    ) x
    where latest_rank = 1
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
select *
from (
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        last3_avg_burst_id,
        temp_c,
        last3_min_burst_id
    from ranked_device_readings_2
) src
unpivot (
    reading for metric_name in (last3_avg_burst_id, temp_c, last3_min_burst_id)
) unp;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .select("*", F.coalesce("humidity", F.lit(0)).alias("humidity_filled"))
)

ranked = (
    valid
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("humidity_filled").desc_nulls_last(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

ranked_device_readings = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "device_code", "reading_ts", "temp_c", "firmware", "dedup_rank")
)

with_prev = ranked_device_readings.withColumn("prev_reading_ts", F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_reading_ts").isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.col("prev_reading_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_device_readings = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "dedup_rank",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    sessions_device_readings
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")) > F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

with_windows = (
    sessionized
    .filter(F.col("burst_id") < 7)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "is_new_session",
        F.min("burst_id").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_min_burst_id"),
        F.avg("burst_id").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_avg_burst_id"),
        F.count("burst_id").over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)).alias("last3_count_burst_id"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("island_id").desc())).alias("island_id_rank"),
    )
)

ranked_device_readings_2 = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("last3_avg_burst_id").desc(), "id")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    ranked_device_readings_2
    .select("id", "device_code", "last3_avg_burst_id", "temp_c", "last3_min_burst_id")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "device_code"],
        values=["last3_avg_burst_id", "temp_c", "last3_min_burst_id"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading").isNotNull())
)
```

```sql
    FROM joined_ranges
```

```python
w_part = Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w_part_2 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("created_at"), "promo").orderBy(F.col("qty_rank").desc_nulls_first())

        F.col("elem.qty"),

with_windows = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("qty").over(w_ordered).alias("promo_avg_qty"),
        F.round((F.col("qty") / F.sum("qty").over(w_ordered)), 4).alias("qty_share"),
        F.max("product_id").over(Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)).alias("product_id_max_30m"),

with_windows_carts = (

    .withColumn("qty_avg_15m", F.avg("qty").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("qty_max_1h", F.max("qty").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("created_at")).orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)))
    .withColumn("qty_rank", F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("qty").desc_nulls_first())))

)

    .withColumn("least_promo_avg_qty_share_qty_share", F.least("promo_avg_qty_share", "qty_share"))
    .withColumn("product_id_max_30m_level", F.when(F.col("product_id_max_30m") >= 9, "High").when(F.col("product_id_max_30m") >= 3, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))

        F.min("promo_avg_qty").over(w_ordered).alias("promo_min_promo_avg_qty"),
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.inbound_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.outbound_count, 0) AS inbound_count_minus_outbound_count
```

```sql
    FROM stock_moves

    FROM flagged

per_session AS (

    SELECT
        move_type,
        burst_id,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(moved_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY move_type, burst_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    move_type,
    burst_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    n_events
FROM per_session
ORDER BY session_start, n_events
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_stock_moves
    .select(
        "id",
        "warehouse_id",

        "move_type",
        "moved_at",
        "unit_price",
    )
)

with_prev = filtered.withColumn("prev_moved_at", F.lag("moved_at").over(Window.partitionBy("move_type").orderBy("moved_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_moved_at").isNull() | ((F.unix_timestamp("moved_at") - F.unix_timestamp("prev_moved_at")) / 60 > 45), 1).otherwise(0))

per_session = (

    .groupBy("move_type", "burst_id")

        F.max("moved_at").alias("session_end"),
```

```python
        F.lag("pkg_price").over(Window.partitionBy("guide_lang").orderBy("posted_on", "id")).alias("prev_pkg_price"),
```

```sql
        tw.rate,
        ROUND(r.kwh * tw.rate, 2) AS energy_cost
    FROM meter_readings r
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

prepared_claims = (
    df_claims
    .filter(~F.col("status").isin("REJECTED", "IN_REVIEW"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "policy_id",
        "adjuster_id",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "reported_at",
        F.least(F.col("claimed_amount"), F.col("approved_amount")).alias("least_claimed_amount_approved_amount"),
        F.least(F.col("approved_amount"), F.col("claimed_amount")).alias("least_approved_amount_claimed_amount"),
        F.round(F.col("approved_amount") * 0.9, 2).alias("approved_amount_adj"),
    )
)

without_matches = (
    prepared_claims
    .crossJoin(prepared_claims.agg(F.max("claimed_amount").alias("overall_max_claimed_amount")))
    .filter(F.col("claimed_amount") < F.col("overall_max_claimed_amount"))
    .drop("overall_max_claimed_amount")
)

latest_per_key = (
    without_matches
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("adjuster_id").orderBy(F.col("approved_amount_adj").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

derived = (
    latest_per_key
    .select(
        "id",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "reported_at",
        "least_claimed_amount_approved_amount",
        "least_approved_amount_claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount_adj",
        F.coalesce(F.col("claimed_amount"), F.lit(0.0)).alias("claimed_amount_filled"),
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("reported_at")).alias("days_since_reported_at"),
    )
)

sequenced = (
    derived
    .select(
        "id",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "reported_at",
        "least_claimed_amount_approved_amount",
        "least_approved_amount_claimed_amount",
        "days_since_reported_at",
        F.ntile(4).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("days_since_reported_at").desc(), "id")).alias("days_since_reported_at_quartile"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("reported_at"))).alias("rows_in_reported_at_month"),
    )
)

screened = (
    sequenced
    .crossJoin(sequenced.agg(F.avg("approved_amount").alias("overall_avg_approved_amount")))
    .filter(F.col("approved_amount") > F.col("overall_avg_approved_amount"))
    .drop("overall_avg_approved_amount")
)

w_days_since_reported_at_quart_3 = Window.partitionBy("days_since_reported_at_quartile").orderBy(F.col("days_since_reported_at").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
sequenced_2 = (
    screened
    .select(
        "id",
        "claimed_amount",
        "approved_amount",
        "reported_at",
        "least_claimed_amount_approved_amount",
        "days_since_reported_at",
        "days_since_reported_at_quartile",
        "rows_in_reported_at_month",
        F.first("rows_in_reported_at_month", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("days_since_reported_at_quartile").orderBy(F.col("rows_in_reported_at_month").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_rows_in_reported_at_month"),
        F.min("rows_in_reported_at_month").over(Window.partitionBy("days_since_reported_at_quartile")).alias("days_since_reported_at_quartile_min_rows_in_repo"),
        F.sum("claimed_amount").over(Window.partitionBy("days_since_reported_at_quartile")).alias("days_since_reported_at_quartile_sum_claimed_amou"),
        F.lead("approved_amount", 1, 0).over(w_days_since_reported_at_quart_3).alias("next_approved_amount"),

    )
)

result = (

        "next_approved_amount",
```

```sql
        l.id AS loan_id,
        l.copies_owned AS loan_copies_owned,
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        "deploy_result",
        "vm_family",
        "cpu_util_pct",
        "paged_at",
        F.dayofweek(F.col("paged_at")).alias("paged_at_dayofweek"),
    )
)

with_prev = prepared.withColumn("prev_paged_at", F.lag("paged_at").over(Window.partitionBy("deploy_result").orderBy("paged_at", "id")))

flagged = (

)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_session").over(Window.partitionBy("deploy_result").orderBy("paged_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

per_session = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("deploy_result", "session_id")
    .agg(

        F.max("paged_at").alias("session_end"),

    )
)

result = (
    per_session
    .select(
        "deploy_result",
        "session_end",
        "n_events",
        F.coalesce(F.col("session_id"), F.lit(0)).alias("session_id_filled"),
```

```python
        "a.customer_id",
        "a.coupon_codes",
        "a.product_id",
        "a.qty",
        F.col("d.country"),
    )

    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([1, 3]))

    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")

enriched = (
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
    GROUP BY a.id, a.pavilion_code, a.enrolled_at
),

    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM in_window
    WHERE prior_rows_1d < (SELECT MAX(prior_rows_1d) FROM in_window)
)
SELECT
    id,
    enrolled_at,
    prior_rows_1d,
```

```python
    df_onyx_frescoes.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_onyx_frescoes.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.pavilion_code") == F.col("a.pavilion_code"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
```

```sql
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY eatery_no

outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_spice_lvl,
        ROUND(s.spice_lvl - g.avg_spice_lvl, 2) AS spice_lvl_minus_avg
    FROM recent s
    JOIN eatery_no_stats g ON g.eatery_no = s.eatery_no
    WHERE s.spice_lvl > g.avg_spice_lvl
),
course_type_stats AS (
    -- Median spice_lvl per course_type
    SELECT course_type, PERCENTILE_APPROX(spice_lvl, 0.5) AS median_spice_lvl
    FROM outliers
    GROUP BY course_type
),
above_average AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_spice_lvl,
        ROUND(s.spice_lvl - g.median_spice_lvl, 2) AS spice_lvl_minus_median
    FROM outliers s
    JOIN course_type_stats g ON g.course_type = s.course_type
    WHERE s.spice_lvl >= g.median_spice_lvl
)
-- Subtotals with ROLLUP
SELECT
    spice_lvl,
    eatery_no,
    GROUPING(spice_lvl) AS is_total_spice_lvl,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
    ROUND(STDDEV(median_spice_lvl), 2) AS stddev_median_spice_lvl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN course_type = 'main' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_course_type_main
FROM above_average
GROUP BY ROLLUP(spice_lvl, eatery_no)
ORDER BY spice_lvl NULLS LAST, eatery_no NULLS LAST
```

```python
    )

    .groupBy("eatery_no")
    .agg(F.avg("spice_lvl").alias("avg_spice_lvl"))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

covered = (
    df_workshops.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_workshops.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.sku_id") == F.col("a.sku_id"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") < F.col("a.moved_at"))
        & (F.col("b.moved_at") >= F.col("a.moved_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.sku_id", "a.moved_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_1d"),
        F.sum("b.unit_price").alias("prior_unit_price_1d"),
    )
)

latest = (
    covered
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("sku_id").orderBy("prior_unit_price_1d", "id")))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

rollup_base = (
    latest
    .groupBy("sku_id")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("prior_unit_price_1d", 0.5).alias("median_prior_unit_price_1d"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.max("moved_at").alias("southern_lagoon"),
        F.min("prior_rows_1d").alias("avatar_level"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.stddev("prior_rows_1d"), 2).alias("stddev_prior_rows_1d"),
    )
)

result = (
    rollup_base
    .groupingSets(
        [["sku_id", "cnt", "avatar_level"], ["sku_id"], []],
        "sku_id", "cnt", "avatar_level",
    )
    .agg(F.max("southern_lagoon").alias("last_last_moved_at"))
```

```sql
    FROM prepared_enrollments
),
qualified AS (

    WHERE EXISTS (

),
latest_per_key AS (

    SELECT

        score_filled,
        grade_status_prefix,
```
