```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.student_id,
        a.enrolled_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS alt_prior_rows_12h,
        SUM(b.lunar_drone) AS prior_score_12h
    FROM quartz_calipers a
    LEFT JOIN quartz_calipers b
      ON b.student_id = a.student_id
     AND b.enrolled_at < a.enrolled_at
     AND b.enrolled_at >= a.enrolled_at - INTERVAL 12 HOURS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.student_id, a.enrolled_at
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(alt_prior_rows_12h / NULLIF(SUM(alt_prior_rows_12h) OVER (PARTITION BY alt_prior_rows_12h, student_id), 0), 4) AS prior_rows_12h_share_of_prior_rows_12h_student_i,
        alt_prior_rows_12h - LAG(alt_prior_rows_12h) OVER (ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prior_rows_12h_change,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY enrolled_at), 3) AS enrolled_at_cume_dist
    FROM in_window
),
student_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg prior_rows_12h_change per student_id
    SELECT student_id, AVG(prior_rows_12h_change) AS avg_prior_rows_12h_change
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY student_id
),
compared AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_prior_rows_12h_change,
        ROUND(s.prior_rows_12h_change - g.avg_prior_rows_12h_change, 2) AS regional_portal
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN student_id_stats g ON g.student_id = s.student_id
    WHERE s.prior_rows_12h_change > g.avg_prior_rows_12h_change
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    student_id,
    enrolled_at,
    alt_prior_rows_12h,
    prior_score_12h,
    prior_rows_12h_share_of_prior_rows_12h_student_i,
    prior_rows_12h_change,
    regional_portal,
    prior_rows_12h_change + prior_score_12h AS willow_dune
FROM compared
WHERE alt_prior_rows_12h BETWEEN 1 AND 7
ORDER BY id DESC
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

in_window = (
    df_quartz_calipers.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_quartz_calipers.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.student_id") == F.col("a.student_id"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") < F.col("a.enrolled_at"))
        & (F.col("b.enrolled_at") >= F.col("a.enrolled_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 12 HOURS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.student_id", "a.enrolled_at")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("alt_prior_rows_12h"),
        F.sum("b.lunar_drone").alias("prior_score_12h"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    in_window
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round(F.col("alt_prior_rows_12h") / F.nullif(F.sum("alt_prior_rows_12h").over(Window.partitionBy("alt_prior_rows_12h", "student_id")), F.lit(0)), 4).alias("prior_rows_12h_share_of_prior_rows_12h_student_i"),
        (F.col("alt_prior_rows_12h") - F.lag("alt_prior_rows_12h").over(Window.orderBy("enrolled_at", "id"))).alias("prior_rows_12h_change"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy("enrolled_at")), 3).alias("enrolled_at_cume_dist"),
    )
)

student_id_stats = (
    metrics
    .groupBy("student_id")
    .agg(F.avg("prior_rows_12h_change").alias("avg_prior_rows_12h_change"))
)

compared = (
    metrics.alias("s")
    .join(student_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.student_id") == F.col("s.student_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.prior_rows_12h_change") > F.col("g.avg_prior_rows_12h_change"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_prior_rows_12h_change",
        F.round(F.col("s.prior_rows_12h_change") - F.col("g.avg_prior_rows_12h_change"), 2).alias("regional_portal"),
    )
)

result = (
    compared
    .filter(F.col("alt_prior_rows_12h").between(1, 7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "student_id",
        "enrolled_at",
        "alt_prior_rows_12h",
        "prior_score_12h",
        "prior_rows_12h_share_of_prior_rows_12h_student_i",
        "prior_rows_12h_change",
        "regional_portal",
        (F.col("prior_rows_12h_change") + F.col("prior_score_12h")).alias("willow_dune"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc())
)
```

```sql
    COALESCE(b.p3_count, 0) AS p3_count,
    b.p3_total_nom_scrap_rate,
    COALESCE(a.p2_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.p3_count, 0) AS p2_count_minus_p3_count
```

```sql
without_matches AS (

stay_channel_stats AS (

        ROUND(s.star_rating - g.median_star_rating, 2) AS star_rating_minus_median

    JOIN stay_channel_stats g ON g.stay_channel = s.stay_channel

combined_details AS (
```
